example: I dashed off a quick reply before boarding the flight to the client’s office. (我登機前匆匆寫了封簡短回覆，要去客戶辦公室。)

example: The data processor compiled monthly sales figures and generated a summary for regional managers. (資料處理人員彙整月銷售數字，並為區域經理產生摘要。)

The airline changed the departure gate and sent a text alert to all passengers. (航空公司更改登機門，並向所有乘客發送簡訊通知。)
Passengers waited in the departure lounge while airport staff completed the final boarding checks. (乘客在候機室等候，機場人員則完成最後登機檢查。)
Our designated driver took everyone back to the hotel after the company dinner. (公司晚宴後，由我們的指定駕駛載大家返回飯店。)
The design team received a faster desktop computer for preparing large presentation files. (設計團隊收到一台更快的桌上型電腦，用來製作大型簡報檔案。)
The training program should do good by helping new employees serve customers more confidently. (這項訓練計畫應能幫助新進員工更有自信地服務顧客。)
The hotel screened a documentary film about local architecture during its cultural evening program. (飯店在文化之夜活動中播放了一部介紹當地建築的紀錄片。)
The marketing team registered a shorter domain name for the new product website. (行銷團隊為新產品網站註冊了較短的網域名稱。)
Once the team was done with the inventory count, the warehouse reopened its loading bays to carriers. (團隊完成庫存盤點後，倉庫便重新開放裝卸區讓承運商進出。)
Please sign on the dotted line and return the completed form to our office by Friday. (請在簽名虛線上簽名，並於週五前將填妥的表格交回辦公室。)
The contract dispute dragged on for months because neither side would accept the proposed delivery guarantee. (由於雙方都不接受提議的交貨保證，合約爭議拖了好幾個月。)
Early on, the sales team identified delivery reliability as the main concern among commercial customers. (初期，業務團隊便發現商用客戶最在意的是交貨可靠度。)
Demand usually eases off after the holiday season, allowing the distribution center to complete routine equipment maintenance. (假期旺季過後，需求通常會減弱，讓配送中心得以進行例行設備維護。)
Use an elastic band to keep the travel documents together inside the folder. (用橡皮筋將旅行文件固定在資料夾內。)
The company added an electric automobile to its fleet for short trips between nearby offices. (公司在車隊中增添一輛電動車，供鄰近辦公室間短程往返使用。)
An electrician inspected the electric circuit after staff reported that the conference room lights kept flickering. (員工回報會議室燈光持續閃爍後，電工檢查了電路。)
The maintenance worker replaced the damaged electric outlet beside the reception desk. (維修人員更換了接待櫃台旁損壞的電源插座。)
The technician moved the copier closer to an electrical outlet before installing the new cable. (技術人員安裝新電纜前，將影印機移到電源插座附近。)
The electrical plant restored power to the business district after crews repaired the damaged line. (工作人員修復受損線路後，發電廠恢復了商業區供電。)
The office manager posted the updated travel policy on the electronic bulletin board for all staff. (辦公室經理將更新後的差旅政策張貼在電子佈告欄，供全體員工查看。)
Even as fuel costs climbed, the carrier maintained the delivery schedule promised to its largest corporate accounts. (正當燃料成本攀升時，承運商仍維持對最大企業客戶承諾的交貨時程。)

meaning: phr. 儘管如此；即便如此
example: The first survey drew few responses; even so, management used the comments to improve its appointment system. (第一份問卷收到的回覆不多；儘管如此，管理階層仍運用意見改善預約系統。)
The travel agent found an excursion rate that lowered the cost of our weekend return ticket. (旅行社找到來回優惠價，降低了我們週末往返票的費用。)
The presentation nearly fell apart when the projector stopped working during the opening slide. (投影片剛開始時投影機故障，簡報差點失控。)
Once the coordinator shared the new schedule, the details of the event began to fall into place. (協調人員公布新時程後，活動細節便逐漸明朗。)
Several customers were fed up with waiting and asked the manager for an updated delivery estimate. (幾位顧客受夠了等待，向經理詢問最新配送時間。)
Please file away the signed contracts so the accounting team can find them later. (請把簽署完成的合約歸檔，方便會計團隊日後查找。)
Please store the signed contracts in the locked file cabinet beside the reception desk. (請將已簽署合約存放在接待櫃台旁的上鎖文件櫃。)
We need to finish up the inventory report before the warehouse closes this afternoon. (我們必須在倉庫今天下午關門前完成庫存報告。)
First of all, please check that every page of the application has been signed. (首先，請確認申請表每一頁都已簽名。)
The travel desk fixed up a rental car for the visiting sales team. (差旅櫃台替來訪的業務團隊安排了一輛租車。)
After missing the shuttle, we flagged down a taxi outside the conference hotel. (錯過接駁車後，我們在會議飯店外揮手攔下一輛計程車。)
The repair crew worked flat out to reopen the store before the weekend. (維修人員全力趕工，讓商店能在週末前重新開門。)
For all intents and purposes, the new distribution center is operational, although one automated line remains offline. (實際上，新的配送中心已開始運作，只有一條自動化產線仍未啟用。)
No one can say for certain whether the replacement shipment will arrive before the stores begin their weekend promotion. (沒有人能確定替換貨物是否會在各門市開始週末促銷前送達。)
For example, the new travel policy requires managers to approve hotel bookings made within two weeks of departure. (例如，新差旅政策要求主管核准出發前兩週內才預訂的飯店。)
The manufacturer closed its obsolete repair facility for good after transferring all technicians to the regional service center. (製造商將所有技術人員調至區域服務中心後，永久關閉了老舊維修廠。)
The purchasing office is holding new orders for the moment while suppliers confirm their updated delivery estimates. (採購辦公室目前暫停新訂單，等候供應商確認更新後的交貨預估。)
For the most part, clients accepted the revised payment schedule once the company explained its temporary cash-flow constraints. (公司說明暫時的現金流限制後，大部分客戶都接受了修訂後的付款時程。)
For the time being, the branch will route complex warranty claims to the regional service center for review. (眼下，分行會將複雜的保固申請轉送區域服務中心審查。)
A request for weekend delivery came from nowhere, forcing the logistics manager to rearrange several carrier shifts. (週末配送需求突然出現，迫使物流經理重新安排幾家承運商的班次。)
A dedicated coordinator monitored the trade fair from start to finish, resolving registration and shipment issues onsite. (專責協調人員全程監督商展，並在現場處理報到與貨運問題。)
The account manager visits long-standing clients from time to time to review changing service needs and renewal plans. (客戶經理不時拜訪長期客戶，檢視不斷變化的服務需求與續約計畫。)
The rental agent showed us the fuel gauge and explained where to return the vehicle. (租車業者指給我們看燃油表，並說明還車地點。)
The hotel manager organized a garage sale to clear out unused furniture before renovation began. (飯店經理在整修開始前舉辦庭院拍賣，清出未使用的家具。)
The driver checked the gas gauge before choosing a service station along the highway. (駕駛人在選擇高速公路沿線加油站前查看了油量表。)
We stopped at a gasoline station to refill the rental car before returning it downtown. (我們在市區還車前到加油站為租來的車加滿油。)
The clinic hired a general practitioner to reduce appointment delays during the busy winter season. (診所增聘一名家庭醫師，以減少冬季旺季的預約延誤。)
The pharmacist explained that the generic drug contains the same active ingredient as the brand name version. (藥師說明這款學名藥含有與品牌藥相同的有效成分。)
Please give back your visitor badge to the receptionist before leaving the building. (離開大樓前，請把訪客證歸還給接待人員。)
The drive to the airport takes about forty minutes, give or take ten minutes during rush hour. (開車到機場約需四十分鐘，尖峰時段上下可能差十分鐘。)
Even after several rejections, Maya did not give up on finding a suitable position. (即使被拒絕好幾次，Maya 仍沒有放棄尋找合適職位。)
Please give way to passengers leaving the train before you board at the station. (在車站上車前，請先讓下車的乘客通行。)
Once the director approves the budget, we can go ahead with the office renovation. (主管核准預算後，我們就能繼續進行辦公室整修。)
There are enough printed programs to go around, so every guest can take one. (印好的節目單數量足夠，每位來賓都能拿到一份。)
The samples may go bad if they remain outside the refrigerator during the delivery. (樣品配送途中若一直放在冰箱外，可能會變質。)
As the weeks go by, the construction team is making steady progress on the new branch. (隨著幾週過去，施工團隊穩定推進新分店工程。)
If anything goes wrong with the order, contact our support desk using the confirmation number. (訂單若有任何差錯，請提供確認編號聯絡客服櫃台。)
The cashier placed the groceries in a reusable grocery bag at the customer request. (收銀員依顧客要求，把食品雜貨放進可重複使用的購物袋。)
I checked the grocery list before leaving the hotel to pick up supplies for the reception. (我離開飯店前查看採買清單，準備購買招待會用品。)
The owner grew up in the neighborhood and later opened her first shop on the same street. (店主在這個社區長大，後來在同一條街開了第一家店。)
Passengers may bring one piece of hand luggage aboard if it fits beneath the seat. (乘客可攜帶一件手提行李登機，前提是能放在座位下方。)
Of the three proposals, this one is hands down the clearest and easiest to implement. (三份提案中，這份毫無疑問最清楚，也最容易執行。)
The technician will hang around the reception area until the replacement printer arrives. (技術人員會在接待區逗留，直到替換印表機送達。)
The contractor stopped at a hardware store to purchase replacement hinges for the office doors. (承包商到五金行購買辦公室門用的替換鉸鏈。)
The invoice discrepancy has to do with a currency conversion error, not with the supplier's listed unit prices. (發票差異與幣別換算錯誤有關，並非供應商列出的單價有誤。)
The health care provider sent the patient a reminder about the annual checkup and clinic hours. (醫療服務者提醒病患年度檢查，並告知診所營業時間。)
The new healthcare facility will open next month, adding examination rooms and extended evening hours for local residents. (新的醫療機構下個月開幕，將增設診間並延長晚間服務時間，方便當地居民。)
The retailer offers free delivery on every home appliance purchased through its website this weekend. (這家零售商本週末透過網站購買家電即可享有免費送貨。)

In all likelihood, the regional office will receive its replacement equipment before the scheduled maintenance shutdown. (區域辦公室很可能會在排定的維護停機前收到替換設備。)
A low price in and of itself does not guarantee value if replacement parts are difficult to obtain. (如果替換零件難以取得，低價本身並不保證產品有價值。)

Keep the courier's contact number in case the delivery window changes while the warehouse is receiving inventory. (倉庫收貨期間，請留著快遞人員的電話，以防配送時段變更。)
Your application is being reviewed, and our hiring team will contact you in due course. (我們正在審查您的申請，招聘團隊會在適當時候聯絡您。)

The support team restored access in no time after identifying the account setting error. (客服團隊找到帳戶設定錯誤後，很快就恢復了使用權限。)
The new distribution center will be in operation before the holiday shopping season begins. (新的配送中心會在假期購物季開始前投入運作。)
Please check that all registration documents are in order before sending the package. (寄出文件前，請確認所有報名資料都已整理妥當。)
The delay was in part caused by severe weather that affected several delivery routes. (這次延誤部分是受到影響多條配送路線的惡劣天氣所致。)

The spokesperson will answer questions in public after the company releases its statement. (公司發布聲明後，發言人會公開回答問題。)
The supplier offered discounted shipping in return for a longer service agreement. (供應商以折扣運費作為延長服務合約的回報。)
The technician replaced the faulty scanner in short order, allowing check-in to continue. (技術人員迅速更換故障掃描器，讓報到作業得以繼續。)

Please move the delivery boxes so they are not in the way of the emergency exit. (請移開配送箱，不要擋住緊急出口。)

meaning: phr. 使用說明書；操作手冊

meaning: phr. 室內裝潢；室內設計
example: The couple hired an interior decorating firm to refresh the reception area before opening their new office. (這對合夥人在新辦公室開幕前，聘請室內裝潢公司整修接待區。)

meaning: phr. 侵犯隱私；侵害隱私權
example: Employees objected that monitoring private messages would be an invasion of privacy. (員工反對監看私人訊息，認為那會侵犯隱私。)

meaning: phr. 即興演奏；即興樂聚
example: The hotel hosted a jam session where local musicians played with guests after the conference dinner. (飯店在研討會晚宴後舉辦即興演奏，讓當地樂手與來賓同台。)
Airport staff guided passengers across the jet bridge after the aircraft reached its assigned gate. (飛機抵達指定登機門後，機場人員引導乘客通過空橋。)
The jet plane was delayed because maintenance crews found a problem during the preflight inspection. (維修人員在起飛前檢查發現問題，因此噴射機延誤起飛。)
The customer returned to the jewelry store after discovering a loose clasp on the new bracelet. (客戶發現新手鍊的扣環鬆脫後，便回到珠寶店處理。)
The unusually high return rate jumped out in the monthly report, prompting the sales director to investigate immediately. (月報中異常偏高的退貨率格外醒目，促使業務主管立即展開調查。)

meaning: phr. 垃圾郵件；廣告郵件

meaning: phr. 開始生效；開始作用

meaning: phr. 筆記型電腦；膝上型電腦

The office replaced its laser printer after repeated jams delayed invoices and client proposals. (辦公室的雷射印表機屢次卡紙，延誤發票與客戶提案後便換了新機。)

meaning: phr. 合法分居；法律分居

meaning: phr. 地方政府；地方主管機關

meaning: phr. 行李置物箱；行李艙

The receptionist asked visitors to make way for a delivery cart carrying replacement computers into the crowded lobby. (櫃檯人員請訪客讓路，讓載著替換電腦的送貨推車通過擁擠的大廳。)

meaning: phr. 遮蔽膠帶；美紋膠帶

meaning: phr. 大眾捷運；大眾快速運輸

More often than not, suppliers respond faster when purchase orders include clear specifications and a named receiving contact. (採購單列明規格和收貨聯絡人時，供應商往往會更快回覆。)
The auditor said the expense records were more or less complete, although three receipts still needed manager approval. (稽核人員表示費用紀錄大致完整，不過仍有三張收據需要主管核准。)
Before the client dinner, Mei checked that her nail polish had dried completely. (客戶晚宴前，美玲確認自己的指甲油已經完全乾了。)
The courier's updated tracking system is no doubt more reliable, giving store managers accurate arrival estimates throughout each day. (快遞公司的新版追蹤系統確實更可靠，讓門市經理每天都能掌握準確的到貨時間。)
The downtown office is no longer accepting paper invoices, so vendors must submit bills through the online portal. (市中心辦公室不再收紙本發票，因此廠商必須透過線上入口網站提交帳單。)
No matter how carefully staff label the cartons, the carrier still requires a separate customs form for each shipment. (不論員工多仔細標示紙箱，承運商仍要求每批貨物各附一份報關表。)
The office coordinator packed odds and ends from the old reception area before the renovation began. (裝修開始前，辦公室協調人員收拾了舊接待區的零碎物品。)
The unexpected price increase caught many customers off guard during the renewal period. (續約期間意外漲價，讓許多顧客措手不及。)
The supplier is not off the hook until it replaces the damaged items at no charge. (供應商免費更換受損商品前，仍不能免除責任。)
The shuttle leaves at eight on the dot, so please be waiting outside beforehand. (接駁車準時八點出發，請提早在外面等候。)
The regional manager is always on the go, visiting stores and meeting local partners. (區域經理總是忙個不停，四處拜訪門市並會見當地合作夥伴。)
On the whole, customers responded positively to the changes in the return policy. (整體而言，顧客對退貨政策的變更反應正面。)
The management team wants to settle the billing dispute once and for all this week. (管理團隊希望本週徹底了結帳單爭議。)
Once in a while, the customer service team receives a request outside normal business hours. (客服團隊偶爾會在正常營業時間外收到需求。)
Please submit the signed forms one at a time so the clerk can check each document. (請一次交一份簽妥的表格，讓辦事員逐份確認。)
The repair should take two hours or so, depending on the availability of replacement parts. (維修大約需要兩小時，視替換零件是否備妥而定。)
The bright poster looked out of place in the hotel’s quiet and elegant lobby. (鮮豔海報放在飯店安靜雅致的大廳裡顯得不太合適。)
Keep the emergency contact list out of reach of visitors while the office is closed. (辦公室關門時，請把緊急聯絡清單放在訪客拿不到的地方。)
The former client called out of the blue and asked for a fresh copy of the proposal. (前客戶突然來電，要求提供一份新的提案副本。)
The technician tested the payment terminal over and over again before returning it to the store. (技術人員一再測試付款終端機，才把它送回商店。)

meaning: phr. 過夜旅行袋；短程旅行袋
example: The consultant packed an overnight bag before catching the early train to the client office. (顧問搭早班火車前，先整理好過夜旅行袋，準備前往客戶辦公室。)
The pilot program panned out better than expected, so the retailer approved a wider rollout across its regional stores. (試辦計畫的成果比預期好，因此零售商核准在各地分店擴大推行。)
The hotel concierge directed visitors to a pedestrian bridge leading safely across the busy avenue. (飯店服務人員指引旅客走人行天橋，安全穿越繁忙的大道。)

meaning: phr. 行人穿越道；斑馬線
example: Drivers must stop at the pedestrian crossing when the signal turns red near the station entrance. (車站入口附近的號誌轉紅時，駕駛必須在行人穿越道前停車。)
The account manager used a pet name for her longtime client, who preferred a warmer tone. (客戶經理用暱稱稱呼合作多年的客戶，因為對方偏好親切的語氣。)

meaning: phr. 代人照顧寵物；到府顧寵
example: She hired a neighbor for pet sitting while attending a three day conference outside the city. (她到外地參加三天研討會時，聘請鄰居到府照顧寵物。)
The rental agent marked the nearest petrol station on the map before the customer drove north. (租車業者在地圖上標出最近的加油站，客戶才開車北上。)
The insurer offered lower premiums to employees who completed an annual physical fitness assessment. (保險公司為完成年度體能評估的員工提供較低保費。)
The tour guide reserved a picnic area where visiting clients could eat lunch between site visits. (導覽人員預留野餐區，讓來訪客戶能在參訪各地點之間用午餐。)

meaning: phr. 短暫停靠；途中休息
example: During the regional sales tour, the team made a brief pit stop before continuing to the client’s office. (區域銷售巡迴途中，團隊短暫休息後再前往客戶辦公室。)

meaning: phr. 持續努力；埋頭苦幹
example: The payroll specialist plugged away at the reconciliation until every disputed entry matched the bank's monthly statement. (薪資專員持續埋頭核對，直到每筆有爭議的紀錄都與銀行月結單相符。)

meaning: phr. 袖珍記事本；口袋行事曆
example: She checked her pocket planner before confirming a client meeting during the regional conference. (她確認區域會議期間的客戶會面前，先查看了袖珍記事本。)
A power outage interrupted the regional office’s operations, so staff redirected urgent calls to the backup center. (停電影響區域辦公室運作，因此員工將緊急來電轉接至備援中心。)
The new scheduling system is pretty much ready, although the support team still needs to test its reminder messages. (新的排班系統幾乎準備就緒，不過支援團隊仍需測試提醒訊息。)
Late evening calls were the price of admission for consultants hoping to secure a role in the overseas project. (深夜通話是顧問爭取參與海外專案必須付出的代價。)

meaning: phr. 公有領域；公共領域
example: The designer chose public domain photographs to avoid licensing fees in the company annual report. (設計師選用公有領域的照片，避免公司年報產生授權費用。)

meaning: phr. 大眾運輸；公共交通
example: The conference hotel offered a transit map showing public transit routes to the airport and downtown offices. (研討會飯店提供交通地圖，標出前往機場與市中心辦公室的大眾運輸路線。)
The small supplier pulled through a difficult quarter after its largest customer agreed to extend payment terms temporarily. (最大客戶同意暫時延長付款期限後，小型供應商挺過了艱難的一季。)
Staff arranged a shuttle from the railway station to the conference hotel for visiting clients. (員工安排接駁車，接送來訪客戶往返火車站與研討會飯店。)

meaning: phr. 快速大眾運輸；捷運系統
example: Visitors used rapid transit to reach the trade center without renting a car during the busy convention. (訪客在繁忙展會期間搭乘快速大眾運輸前往商展中心，無須租車。)
The company rented a recreational vehicle for technicians traveling between remote project sites over the weekend. (公司租了一輛休旅車，供技術人員週末往返偏遠的專案據點。)

meaning: phr. 回收箱；資源回收桶
example: Staff placed the empty packaging in the recycling bin after removing labels that contained customer information. (員工撕下含有客戶資料的標籤後，把空包裝放進回收箱。)

meaning: phr. 緊急警報；最高警戒
example: The airport issued a red alert when severe weather forced several international flights to divert. (惡劣天候迫使數班國際航班改道後，機場發布了緊急警報。)

meaning: phr. 參考手冊；操作指南
example: The technician consulted the reference manual before updating the payment terminal's network settings. (技術人員更新刷卡機的網路設定前，先查閱了參考手冊。)
Many clients regard prompt updates as essential, particularly when a delivery delay could disrupt their own scheduled operations. (許多客戶視即時更新為必要服務，尤其是配送延誤可能影響自家排程時。)
The new bus route connects the residential area with the downtown office district every fifteen minutes. (新的公車路線每十五分鐘連接住宅區與市中心辦公商圈。)
The hotel sits in a residential district, so guests should keep noise low after evening hours. (飯店位於住宅區，住客晚間應降低音量。)
The company reminded drivers to report road rage incidents instead of confronting aggressive motorists. (公司提醒駕駛員通報路怒事件，不要與具攻擊性的駕駛起衝突。)
The hotel’s front desk operates round the clock to assist guests arriving on late flights. (飯店櫃台全天候服務，協助搭乘晚班機抵達的房客。)
I ran across the former branch manager at the trade show last week. (我上週在商展上偶然遇見前任分店經理。)
With careful preparation, the team sailed through the safety inspection without any major issues. (準備周全後，團隊順利通過安全檢查，沒有重大問題。)

meaning: phr. 心理慰藉；安全感來源
example: For the new manager, weekly check-ins with a trusted mentor became a security blanket during the restructuring. (對新任主管而言，重整期間每週與信任的導師會談成了心理慰藉。)

meaning: phr. 購物籃；手提購物籃
example: Customers left their shopping baskets near the exit while staff restocked the produce shelves. (員工補貨時，顧客把購物籃放在出口附近。)
A customer left a shopping cart near the entrance, blocking the delivery crew's path. (有位顧客把購物推車留在入口附近，擋住了送貨人員的通道。)

meaning: phr. 銀婚紀念日；結婚二十五週年
example: They marked their silver wedding anniversary with a family dinner at the restaurant. (他們在餐廳舉辦家庭晚餐，慶祝銀婚紀念日。)
Before approving the vendor proposal, the director skimmed over the summary and then reviewed the detailed pricing schedule. (核准供應商提案前，主管先略讀摘要，再檢視詳細的價格表。)
The renewal deadline slipped his mind during a week of back-to-back client visits. (那一週他忙著連續拜訪客戶，完全忘了續約期限。)
A junior analyst slipped up when entering the invoice number, but accounting corrected the record before payment. (初階分析師輸入發票號碼時出了差錯，但會計部在付款前修正紀錄。)
The logistics team slowed down dispatches until the warehouse completed its scheduled inventory and safety checks. (倉庫完成預定盤點與安全檢查前，物流團隊放慢了出貨速度。)

meaning: phr. 小人物；無足輕重者
example: The investor dismissed local competitors as small fry, overlooking their loyal customer base. (投資人把當地競爭者當成小角色，忽略了他們忠實的客群。)
The office snack bar will remain open during renovations to the building's main cafeteria. (大樓主要員工餐廳整修期間，辦公室點心吧仍會營業。)
When the client mentioned delayed invoices, a clearer approval workflow sprang to mind for the finance director. (客戶提到發票延遲時，財務主管立刻想到更清楚的核准流程。)
The courier called the warehouse straight off after discovering that several cartons were missing from the morning delivery. (快遞員發現早上的貨少了幾箱，立刻打電話通知倉庫。)

meaning: phr. 嚴格來說；確切而言
example: Strictly speaking, the reimbursement deadline is Friday, although the finance office usually accepts complete claims through Monday. (嚴格來說，報帳期限是星期五，不過財務室通常接受週一前送齊的申請。)
Several small businesses subscribe to the monthly market bulletin to receive updates about shipping rates and local regulations. (幾家小型企業訂閱每月市場簡報，定期取得運費和地方規定的最新資訊。)
The city froze the subway fare this year, easing commuting costs for employees who travel daily. (市府今年凍漲地鐵票價，減輕每天通勤員工的交通支出。)
All branch offices will switch over to the new scheduling system next Monday. (所有分店下週一都會改用新的排班系統。)
After the client's bereavement, the account team sent a sympathy card signed by colleagues across the office. (客戶家中有喪事後，客戶團隊寄了一張由辦公室同事共同署名的慰問卡。)
Traveling sales staff use a tablet computer to review product specifications and submit orders during client visits. (外勤業務人員拜訪客戶時，會用平板電腦查看產品規格並提交訂單。)
We decided to take a chance on the new supplier after checking its references. (查看推薦資料後，我們決定冒險一試，採用這家新供應商。)
Long-term clients should not be taken for granted, even when they renew every year. (即使長期客戶年年續約，也不該把他們的支持視為理所當然。)
Please take notice of the updated room assignments posted beside the reception desk. (請留意接待櫃台旁張貼的最新房間分配表。)
More than fifty local businesses will take part in the employment fair next month. (下個月將有五十多家當地企業參加就業博覽會。)
The new employee took the trainer’s advice to heart and improved her customer service. (新進員工把訓練員的建議銘記在心，改善了客服表現。)
The colleagues tried not to talk shop during dinner with their visiting families. (同事和來訪的家人共進晚餐時，努力不談工作。)

meaning: phr. 計程車車資；搭車費
example: The client asked whether the taxi fare from the airport could be reimbursed with the travel expenses. (客戶詢問從機場搭計程車的車資能否列入差旅費報銷。)
Managers should think twice before sharing client contact details with an outside contractor who has not signed a confidentiality agreement. (主管將客戶聯絡資料交給尚未簽署保密協議的外包廠商前，應該三思。)
The owner refused to throw in the towel after losing two major accounts and instead revised the company's service plan. (失去兩個主要客戶後，業主仍不肯認輸，反而重新修訂公司的服務方案。)
Thus far, the revised scheduling process has reduced missed appointments without increasing the workload for reception staff. (到目前為止，修訂後的排程流程減少了失約情況，櫃檯人員的工作量也沒有增加。)
Before sending the purchase order, the assistant ticked off every item against the supplier's final quote and delivery schedule. (寄出採購單前，助理逐項核對供應商的最終報價和交貨時程。)
A staff member at the ticket booth helped the client exchange a reservation for an earlier train. (售票處的工作人員協助客戶把訂位換成較早班次的火車。)
The branch manager is tied up with a supplier meeting this morning, but she can review the revised contract after lunch. (分店經理上午忙著和供應商開會，但午餐後可以檢視修訂後的合約。)
Time and again, customers told the service team that clear delivery updates mattered more than small discounts. (顧客一再告訴客服團隊，清楚的配送進度更新比小額折扣更重要。)
A time lag between the payment and the confirmation email confused several customers. (付款與確認電子郵件之間的時間差讓幾位客戶感到困惑。)

meaning: phr. 出發時間；離開時間
example: Please confirm the time of departure with the driver before the client leaves the hotel lobby. (請在客戶離開飯店大廳前，向司機確認出發時間。)

meaning: phr. 產權契據；所有權狀
example: The buyer checked the title deed before transferring the final payment for the downtown apartment. (買方在支付市中心公寓尾款前，先確認了產權契據。)
To begin with, the regional office will update its vendor directory before requesting new bids for the delivery contract. (首先，區域辦公室會更新廠商名錄，再徵求配送合約的新報價。)
To date, the loyalty program has attracted more repeat customers than the previous discount campaign did. (截至目前，會員計畫吸引的回購客戶比先前的折扣活動更多。)
Please submit the signed purchase order together with the updated tax form before the accounting department closes its monthly records. (請在會計部門結清月帳前，連同更新後的稅務表格一起提交已簽署的採購單。)
The rental company warned visitors that crossing the toll bridge required an electronic payment tag. (租車公司提醒旅客，通過收費橋需要使用電子繳費標籤。)

meaning: phr. 收費道路；收費公路
example: The driver chose a toll road to reach the airport before the morning traffic became heavy. (司機選擇走收費道路，在早晨車潮變得擁擠前抵達機場。)
Roadside assistance sent a tow truck after the client reported a flat tire near the highway exit. (客戶通報在高速公路出口附近爆胎後，道路救援派出拖吊車。)

meaning: phr. 經過驗證；可靠有效
example: The operations team kept its tried and true inventory checks while piloting a new forecasting tool at two locations. (營運團隊試行新預測工具時，仍保留原本經過驗證的庫存檢查方式。)
Please pay the tuition fee by Friday to keep your place in the evening course. (請在星期五前繳學費，以保留晚間課程名額。)

meaning: phr. 在此情況下；考量當前狀況
example: Under the circumstances, the hotel offered affected guests a complimentary meal and extended checkout while repairs continued. (考量當前狀況，飯店在維修期間提供受影響的住客免費餐點並延後退房。)

meaning: phr. 最新的；符合現況的
example: Please keep the employee directory up to date so supervisors can reach the correct contact during an urgent shift change. (請維持員工名錄資訊最新，讓主管在緊急換班時能聯絡到正確人員。)

meaning: phr. 忙得不可開交；深陷其中
example: The logistics planners are up to their necks in year-end orders, but they are still responding to urgent customer requests. (物流規劃人員被年終訂單忙得不可開交，仍得回覆緊急客戶需求。)
Passengers seated on the upper deck can use the lounge near the front stairs. (坐在上層甲板的乘客可以使用前方樓梯旁的休息室。)
The updated user interface makes it easier to find invoices and track pending orders. (更新後的使用者介面讓人更容易查找發票和追蹤待處理訂單。)
The owner offered the vacant lot for lease to a business planning a small café. (屋主將空地出租給一間打算開小咖啡館的商家。)
They rent out their vacation home during winter and use the income for repairs. (他們冬天出租度假屋，並用收入支付維修費。)
The coastal town has become a popular vacation spot for families traveling by train. (這座海岸小鎮已成為搭火車出遊家庭的熱門度假地。)
The hotel replaced every vacuum cleaner before the busy summer season began. (飯店在繁忙的夏季開始前更換了所有吸塵器。)
Facilities staff emptied the waste basket beside each workstation before the client audit began. (客戶稽核開始前，設施人員清空了每個工作站旁的廢紙簍。)

meaning: phr. 飲水機；茶水間飲水機
example: A notice beside the water cooler reminded staff to report leaks to the facilities team. (飲水機旁的公告提醒員工，發現漏水要通知設施管理團隊。)

meaning: phr. 天氣預報；天氣展望
example: The weather outlook prompted the travel coordinator to move the outdoor client event indoors. (天氣預報顯示狀況不佳，促使差旅協調人員把戶外客戶活動移到室內。)

meaning: phr. 網頁瀏覽器；瀏覽軟體
example: The new web browser lets employees access invoices securely without installing extra software. (新版網頁瀏覽器讓員工無須安裝額外軟體，也能安全查看發票。)

meaning: phr. 結婚紀念日；婚姻紀念日
example: He booked a restaurant for their wedding anniversary after checking the supplier visit schedule. (他確認供應商拜訪行程後，替兩人的結婚紀念日訂了餐廳。)
The company hosted a wedding reception at its garden venue after the founder’s daughter was married. (創辦人的女兒結婚後，公司在庭園場地舉辦了婚宴。)

meaning: phr. 掃興的人；潑冷水者
example: The finance director was no wet blanket; she supported a modest celebration after the team met its targets. (財務主管並非掃興的人，團隊達成目標後，她也支持簡單慶祝。)
The new delivery option is faster and, what is more, it lets customers choose a two-hour arrival window. (新的配送選項速度更快，而且還讓顧客選擇兩小時的送達時段。)
After two interviews, the candidate wound up accepting a position at the regional office. (經過兩次面試，候選人最後接受了地區辦公室的職位。)

meaning: phr. 玻璃清潔工；窗戶清潔員
example: A window cleaner arrived before opening to wash the glass frontage of the downtown branch. (市中心分店開門前，玻璃清潔工就先來清洗整面玻璃門面。)

meaning: phr. 文書處理器；文字處理軟體
example: The word processor saved edits automatically before the finance analyst sent the final report. (財務分析師寄出最終報告前，文書處理器已自動儲存修改內容。)
After managing the conference for three days, the entire events team felt worn out. (連續三天籌辦會議後，整個活動團隊都筋疲力盡。)
The revised meeting schedule is as follows: registration begins at nine, followed by two client presentations. (修訂後的會議時程如下：九點開始報到，接著安排兩場客戶簡報。)
The presenter used a bar graph to compare monthly sales across the company’s regions. (簡報者用長條圖比較公司各地區的月銷售額。)
The chair brought forward the budget vote after members reviewed the final cost estimates earlier than expected. (成員比預期更早審閱完最終成本估算後，主席便提前進行預算表決。)
The audit findings brought home the cost of weak record keeping to managers across every regional office. (稽核結果讓各區域辦公室的主管充分了解紀錄管理不善所付出的代價。)

meaning: phr. 提醒注意；引起注意
example: The auditor called attention to missing receipts before the department submitted its annual travel expense report. (部門提交年度差旅費報告前，稽核員提醒大家注意缺少的收據。)

meaning: phr. 宣布開會；請會議開始
example: The chair called the meeting to order once all regional representatives had taken their seats. (各區域代表就座後，主席便宣布會議開始。)
When asked about possible partners, two reliable distributors came to mind immediately for the regional expansion. (被問到可能的合作夥伴時，我立刻想到兩家可靠的經銷商，可支援區域擴張。)
Several practical options came up during the review, including extending support hours and simplifying the returns process. (檢討期間提出了幾個可行方案，包括延長支援時段及簡化退貨流程。)
The facilitator drew out concerns from quieter participants before the committee voted on the revised customer survey. (委員會表決修訂後的顧客問卷前，主持人先引導較安靜的與會者說出疑慮。)
The audit report drove home why accurate supplier records matter when regulators request evidence of origin. (稽核報告清楚點出，監管機關要求產地證明時，正確的供應商紀錄有多重要。)
In brief, the proposal reduces delivery delays by adding a local depot and standardizing weekend dispatch procedures. (簡言之，這項提案透過增設當地轉運站及統一週末派送流程來減少延誤。)
The chair kicked off the quarterly review by summarizing client feedback and outlining the meeting's key decisions. (主席先摘要客戶意見並說明會議的重要決策，正式啟動了季度檢討。)
Last but not least, the operations director thanked frontline staff whose weekend coverage kept every branch open. (最後但同樣重要的是，營運主管感謝週末值班、讓所有分行維持營業的第一線員工。)
A series of supplier workshops led up to the final contract review with the company's regional procurement director. (一連串供應商工作坊為與公司區域採購主管進行的最後合約審查鋪路。)

meaning: phr. 午餐會議；工作午餐
example: The regional director scheduled a luncheon meeting with the distributor to discuss delivery delays. (區域主管安排與經銷商舉行午餐會議，討論配送延誤。)

meaning: phr. 口頭報告；口頭簡報
example: The consultant delivered an oral presentation summarizing the survey findings for senior managers. (顧問向高階主管進行口頭簡報，摘要說明調查結果。)
The analyst used a pie chart to show how operating expenses were divided among the company departments. (分析師用圓餅圖呈現營運費用如何分配到公司各部門。)
The architect sketched out a revised floor plan so department leaders could discuss staffing and visitor flow. (建築師概述修訂後的樓層配置，讓部門主管討論人力安排與訪客動線。)
The presenter skipped over the technical appendix and focused the meeting on implementation costs and delivery dates. (簡報者略過技術附錄，將會議重點放在執行成本與交付日期。)

meaning: phr. 指導委員會；統籌小組
example: A steering committee will review the rollout schedule and resolve disagreements between the regional implementation teams. (指導委員會將審查推行時程，並解決各區執行團隊之間的分歧。)
At the stockholders meeting, executives answered questions about declining revenue and the proposed restructuring plan. (在股東會上，高階主管回答了有關營收下滑及重整計畫的提問。)
The coordinator reserved a time slot for the regional sales team to review the revised forecast. (協調人員預留一個時段，讓區域業務團隊檢視修訂後的預測。)
The director touched on the staffing changes during the briefing but reserved detailed questions for the department meeting. (主管在簡報中簡要提及人事調整，但將詳細問題留到部門會議再討論。)
The vice chairperson led the budget meeting after the chair took an unexpected call from regulators. (主席突然接到主管機關來電後，由副主席主持預算會議。)
All contractors must abide by the revised safety rules before entering the distribution center's loading area. (所有承包商進入物流中心裝卸區前，都必須遵守修訂後的安全規定。)
Management approved pay increases across the board after quarterly profits exceeded the company's forecast. (季度獲利超出公司預估後，管理階層核准全面調薪。)
The compliance team acted on customer complaints and revised the procedure for verifying overseas transactions. (法遵團隊根據客訴採取行動，修訂了海外交易的查核程序。)
Unexpected customs delays added to the shipment's cost and pushed the launch date back by several days. (意外的海關延誤增加了這批貨物的成本，也讓上市日期延後數日。)

meaning: phr. 爭分奪秒；趕在期限前
example: The response team worked against the clock to restore online payments before the weekend sales began. (應變團隊爭分奪秒，在週末促銷開始前恢復線上付款。)
Both departments followed the timeline they had agreed upon after finance approved the revised project budget. (財務部核准修訂後的專案預算後，兩個部門都依照商定時程執行。)

meaning: phr. 領先一步；占得先機
example: By renewing supplier contracts early, the purchasing team stayed ahead of the game during the holiday rush. (採購團隊提早續簽供應商合約，在假期旺季中保持領先。)
The schedule will allow for customs inspections and possible weather delays along the northern shipping route. (專案時程已將海關檢查及北部航線可能遇到的天候延誤納入考量。)
The regional manager must answer for the unexplained inventory losses before the next quarterly review. (區域經理必須在下次季度檢討前，為無法說明的庫存損失負責。)

meaning: phr. 仲裁條款；仲裁約定
example: The supplier requested an arbitration clause in the contract to resolve payment disputes without delaying future deliveries. (供應商要求在合約中加入仲裁條款，以解決付款爭議並避免延誤後續交貨。)
The committee aimed to arrive at a consensus on which markets deserved investment after reviewing current sales figures. (檢視銷售數據後，委員會就哪些市場值得追加投資得出共識。)

meaning: phr. 公司章程；設立文件
example: The founders filed the articles of incorporation with the state before opening a business bank account or hiring employees. (創辦人在開立公司銀行帳戶或聘用員工前，先向州政府提交公司設立文件。)
The logistics provider was at fault for sending the temperature-sensitive goods to the wrong regional depot. (物流業者把需控溫貨品送錯區域轉運站，必須為此負責。)
The two departments were at odds over which team should handle the new account. (兩個部門對該由哪個團隊負責新客戶意見不合。)
The contract renewal is at stake, so the team must resolve the client’s concerns today. (續約攸關重大，因此團隊今天必須解決客戶的疑慮。)
The company plans to add a second shift at its automobile factory next year. (公司計畫明年在汽車工廠增設第二班。)
The report examines how rising fuel costs are affecting the automobile industry. (報告探討燃料成本上漲如何影響汽車產業。)
Mina is always on the ball and notices small errors before a report is sent. (Mina 一向機警能幹，總能在報告寄出前發現小錯誤。)
The latest sales figures bear out the manager’s forecast for steady growth this year. (最新銷售數據證實經理對今年穩定成長的預測。)
The company plans to beef up customer support before launching its new online service. (公司計畫在推出新線上服務前加強客服。)

meaning: phr. 密切相關；緊密相連
example: The firm's reputation is bound up with the reliability of its repair service and the quality of replacement parts. (公司的聲譽與維修服務的可靠度及替換零件的品質密切相關。)
The regional report warns that high housing costs could cause a brain drain among young professionals. (區域報告警告，高房價可能造成青年專業人才外流。)

meaning: phr. 拓展業務；擴大範圍
example: The consulting firm plans to branch out into renewable energy after building a strong portfolio in transportation projects. (這家顧問公司在交通專案累積穩固實績後，計畫拓展再生能源業務。)
The supplier faced a breach of contract claim after failing to deliver the replacement equipment by the date specified in the agreement. (供應商未依協議指定日期交付替換設備，因此面臨違約求償。)
The review found a breach of duty when the supervisor approved expenses without checking the supporting invoices. (審查發現主管未核對佐證發票就核准費用，構成違反職責。)

meaning: phr. 背信；違反信託義務
example: Sharing confidential client files with an unauthorized contractor was considered a serious breach of trust by the firm's leadership. (將機密客戶檔案分享給未獲授權的承包商，被公司高層視為嚴重背信。)
Negotiators broke off talks after the supplier refused to guarantee delivery dates for the peak season. (供應商拒絕保證旺季交期後，談判代表中止了會談。)
The research team broke through a regulatory barrier by presenting clearer safety data to the review panel. (研究團隊向審查小組提出更清楚的安全數據，終於突破法規障礙。)
The incoming director chose to break with tradition and publish performance targets before the annual planning meeting. (新任主管決定打破慣例，在年度規劃會議前公布績效目標。)
The account director brought the client around by offering a phased rollout instead of an immediate full conversion. (客戶主管提出分階段導入方案，而非立即全面轉換，終於說服了客戶。)
The procurement team renegotiated shipping terms to bring down freight costs without delaying customer orders. (採購團隊重新協商運送條件，在不延誤客戶訂單的情況下降低運費。)
The negotiator brought to bear detailed cost data when the vendor challenged the proposed service fee. (廠商質疑提議的服務費時，談判代表運用了詳細的成本數據。)

meaning: phr. 不予理會；置之不理
example: The director brushed aside early warnings until a second equipment failure forced management to suspend production. (主管起初不理會警訊，直到設備再次故障，管理階層才被迫停產。)
Concerns about delayed reimbursements bubbled up during the staff meeting and prompted finance to review its process. (員工會議中逐漸浮現報銷延遲的疑慮，促使財務部檢討流程。)
The contract builds in a thirty-day review period before either party can change the service fee. (合約納入三十天的檢視期，雙方在此期間內都不能調整服務費。)
The revised training program builds on feedback from branch managers who handled the previous product launch. (修訂後的訓練方案以曾負責前次產品上市的分行經理意見為基礎。)

meaning: phr. 繁瑣程序；官僚流程
example: A bureaucratic procedure delayed the equipment permit, so the project manager contacted the city office for clarification. (繁瑣的行政程序延誤設備許可，專案經理因此聯絡市府確認。)
The founders agreed to buy out their former partner after an independent valuation settled the firm's ownership dispute. (獨立估值解決公司股權爭議後，創辦人同意買下前合夥人的持股。)
The operations director requested a temporary extension to buy time while engineers confirmed the replacement components. (營運主管申請暫時展延，以便爭取時間讓工程師確認替換零件。)
A competitor tried to buy up the remaining shares before the merger proposal reached the other shareholders. (競爭對手試圖在合併提案送達其他股東前買下剩餘股份。)
The revised form places the privacy notice beside the signature field by design, making it harder to overlook. (修訂後的表格刻意將隱私告知放在簽名欄旁，讓填表者不容易忽略。)

meaning: phr. 反覆試驗；逐步摸索
example: The support team refined its troubleshooting guide by trial and error before releasing the instructions to customers. (客服團隊反覆試驗並修改疑難排解指南，之後才將說明發布給客戶。)
The unexplained revisions call into question whether the consultant's final cost estimate reflects the approved scope. (無法說明的修訂讓人質疑顧問的最終成本估算是否符合核准範圍。)

meaning: phr. 發號施令；掌控決策
example: Although several departments contributed, the project sponsor called the shots on timing and final product specifications. (雖然多個部門都參與其中，專案贊助人仍掌控時程與最終產品規格。)
A temporary director carried on the business while the board searched for a permanent chief executive. (董事會尋找正式執行長期間，由一名代理主管繼續經營公司。)

meaning: phr. 延續；沿用至下一階段
example: Any unresolved client requests will carry over to the incoming support team when the service contract changes. (服務合約轉換時，尚未解決的客戶要求會延續至接手的支援團隊。)
Management carried through the planned restructuring despite resistance from several senior department heads. (儘管幾位資深部門主管反對，管理階層仍貫徹了預定的組織重整。)
Her recommendation carries weight because she has managed the account through three major service transitions. (她曾負責該客戶三次重大服務轉換，因此她的建議很有分量。)

meaning: phr. 趕上進度；補上落後
example: The billing team worked through lunch to catch up on invoices delayed by last week's software outage. (帳務團隊午休時仍繼續工作，趕上上週軟體故障所延誤的發票處理。)
The quarterly discussion will center on customer retention, product reliability, and the cost of expanding support coverage. (季度討論將聚焦於顧客留存、產品可靠度，以及擴大支援範圍的成本。)

meaning: phr. 公司設立證明；法人登記證
example: The bank requested the certificate of incorporation before opening a business account for the newly registered company. (銀行在為新登記公司開立商業帳戶前，要求提供公司設立證明。)
The downtown hotel changed hands after its owners accepted an offer from an international hospitality group. (業主接受國際旅宿集團的收購提案後，市中心飯店便易主了。)

meaning: phr. 創始會員；創會成員
example: As a charter member of the trade association, the retailer helped shape its initial standards for responsible sourcing. (身為貿易協會的創始會員，這家零售商協助制定初期的責任採購標準。)
The compliance officer checked into the vendor's registration documents before approving the new service agreement. (法遵人員核准新的服務合約前，先查核了廠商的登記文件。)
The project manager checked over the revised cost sheet before forwarding it to the finance director. (專案經理將修訂後的成本表轉交財務主管前，先仔細核對一遍。)

meaning: phr. 逐步削減；慢慢削弱
example: The operations team chipped away at the delivery backlog by resolving the oldest customer orders first. (營運團隊優先處理最早的客戶訂單，逐步消化積壓的交貨工作。)
The change came about after customer interviews revealed that the return policy was confusing first-time buyers. (顧客訪談發現退貨政策令首次購買者困惑後，這項變革便因此產生。)

meaning: phr. 改變想法；轉而同意
example: After reviewing the pilot results, the skeptical franchise owners came around to the proposed ordering system. (檢視試辦結果後，原本持懷疑態度的加盟店業主轉而同意採用提議的訂購系統。)
The proposed delivery fee came in for criticism because customers had not been told about it at checkout. (由於結帳時未告知顧客，這項配送費提案招致批評。)
Online invoicing came of age when small retailers could finally reconcile payments without specialized accounting software. (小型零售商終於能不用專業會計軟體核對款項時，線上開票服務便進入成熟期。)
The executive team came to grips with declining renewals by interviewing former customers and revising service terms. (主管團隊訪談流失客戶並修訂服務條款，正視續約率下滑的問題。)
The discrepancy came to light during an internal audit, prompting the company to review every regional account. (內部稽核期間，這項差異曝光，促使公司檢視所有區域帳戶。)
The review will concentrate on recurring billing errors rather than redesigning the entire customer database. (這次檢討將專注於重複發生的帳務錯誤，而非重新設計整個客戶資料庫。)
All proposals must conform to the company’s purchasing rules before managers can approve them. (所有提案都必須符合公司的採購規定，主管才能核准。)
Every branch should review its contingency procedure before the annual safety inspection. (每間分店都應在年度安全檢查前檢視應變程序。)
The launch date is contingent on final approval from the regional office. (上市日期取決於地區辦公室的最終核准。)
The audit team found that a supervisor tried to cover up several missing receipts. (稽核團隊發現一位主管試圖掩蓋幾張收據遺失的情況。)
The company will crack down on unauthorized purchases made with corporate credit cards. (公司將嚴加取締未經授權使用公司信用卡購物的行為。)
We should not cut corners on safety checks just to finish the installation earlier. (我們不該為了提早完成安裝而在安全檢查上偷工省錢。)
The court entered a default judgment after the defendant failed to respond to the claim. (被告未回應訴訟後，法院作出了缺席判決。)
The defense contractor submitted a revised delivery schedule for the communications equipment. (國防承包商提交了通訊設備的修訂交貨時程。)
The final schedule will depend upon when the equipment arrives at the warehouse. (最終時程將取決於設備何時送達倉庫。)
Reducing delivery hours was a desperate measure to keep the branch operating during renovations. (縮短配送時段是緊急手段，目的是讓分店在整修期間繼續營運。)
The manufacturer signed a distribution agreement with a regional partner to expand its retail network. (製造商與區域夥伴簽訂經銷協議，以擴大零售通路。)
Management plans to do away with paper forms and move all requests online. (管理層計畫廢除紙本表格，將所有申請改為線上辦理。)
Our claims team did its best to resolve every open case before the revised customer service standards took effect. (修訂後的客服標準生效前，我們的理賠團隊盡力處理每一件未結案件。)

meaning: phr. 表現良好；進展順利
example: The downtown branch did well after extending weekend hours and promoting its new business banking services. (市中心分行延長週末營業時間並推廣企業銀行服務後，業績表現良好。)
The negotiator refused to drag unrelated departments in while the two companies settled their delivery dispute. (兩家公司協調交貨爭議時，談判代表拒絕把無關部門牽扯進來。)
The agency dragged its feet on issuing the permit, forcing the contractor to postpone the planned site inspection. (主管機關拖延核發許可，迫使承包商延後原定的現場檢查。)

meaning: phr. 劃定界線；設定限度
example: The purchasing director drew the line at accepting delivery terms that left the company responsible for customs penalties. (採購主管拒絕接受會讓公司承擔海關罰款責任的交貨條款，劃清了界線。)
The recall drew together sales, logistics, and customer service teams around one coordinated response plan. (這次產品召回凝聚了業務、物流與客服團隊，共同執行一套協調方案。)
The marketing group dreamed up a loyalty program that rewarded repeat customers without discounting premium products. (行銷團隊構思了一套會員方案，獎勵回購顧客但不降低高階產品價格。)
The installation team dropped behind schedule when a delayed shipment left several offices without replacement routers. (替換用路由器延遲送達，讓安裝團隊的進度落後。)
Two bidders dropped out after the client extended the project timeline without increasing the available contract budget. (客戶延長專案時程卻未增加合約預算後，有兩家投標商退出了競標。)
The account manager dropped the ball by overlooking the renewal notice, leaving the client without service for two days. (客戶經理漏看續約通知，犯下疏失，導致客戶兩天無法使用服務。)
The investment plan will improve economic infrastructure by upgrading ports, roads, and regional power networks. (投資計畫將透過改善港口、道路與區域電網，提升經濟基礎建設。)
All employees must review the ethical code before handling confidential customer information. (所有員工處理機密客戶資料前，都必須閱讀道德規範。)
The supervisor had to face the music after approving an order without checking the final price. (主管未核對最終價格就核准訂單，因此必須承擔後果。)
When estimating delivery times, please factor in possible delays at the border. (估算配送時間時，請把邊境可能發生的延誤納入考量。)
All regional offices must fall in line with the updated expense policy by July. (所有地區辦公室都必須在七月前遵守更新後的支出政策。)
This quarter’s sales fell short of the target, despite strong results in the northern region. (儘管北部業績亮眼，本季銷售仍未達到目標。)
The lease agreement fell through when the building owner changed the terms at the last minute. (大樓屋主最後一刻更改條件，租約因此告吹。)
The support team created a feedback loop so product managers could respond quickly to recurring complaints. (客服團隊建立回饋循環，讓產品經理能迅速處理重複出現的客訴。)
The hiring manager called the candidate to feel out her interest in a second interview. (招聘經理打電話試探候選人是否有意參加第二次面試。)
The software can filter out duplicate applications before the recruiting team reviews them. (招聘團隊審閱前，這套軟體可以篩除重複的申請。)
The event coordinator will firm up the catering order after receiving the final guest count. (活動協調人員收到最終來賓人數後會敲定餐飲訂單。)
The minister outlined a fiscal policy focused on infrastructure spending and stable public revenue. (部長說明了著重基礎建設支出與穩定公共收入的財政政策。)
This meeting room fits the bill because it has a screen and seats twenty people. (這間會議室符合需求，因為有螢幕且可容納二十人。)
The consultant prepared a flow diagram showing how customer orders move through the accounting system. (顧問製作流程圖，呈現客戶訂單如何經過會計系統處理。)
One branch introduced weekend service, and several nearby offices soon followed suit. (一間分店推出週末服務後，附近幾間辦公室很快跟進。)
The project lead followed through on the promised repairs before the hotel reopened its conference facilities. (專案負責人在飯店重新開放會議設施前，完成了承諾的修繕工作。)
The audit uncovered a fraudulent scheme that diverted vendor payments into an unauthorized account. (稽核揭露一項詐欺計畫，將供應商款項轉入未授權帳戶。)
The director gave the marketing team free rein to redesign the campaign for regional customers. (主管授予行銷團隊自由決定權，讓他們為區域客戶重新設計活動。)
Smaller distributors felt frozen out after the manufacturer awarded exclusive territories to two national chains. (製造商將獨家銷售區域交給兩家全國連鎖後，較小的經銷商覺得遭到排擠。)

meaning: phr. 從頭開始；白手起家
example: The consultant built a regional vendor database from scratch after discovering that existing records were incomplete and outdated. (顧問發現現有紀錄不完整且過時後，從頭建立了一套區域供應商資料庫。)
The report describes how rising shipping costs have affected the garment industry this year. (報告說明今年運費上漲如何影響成衣業。)
Small suppliers can get ahead by responding quickly to purchase requests and keeping accurate delivery records. (小型供應商若能迅速回覆採購需求並維持準確交貨紀錄，就能取得優勢。)

meaning: phr. 終於著手；抽空處理
example: The facilities manager finally got around to replacing the aging elevators after the annual inspection identified safety concerns. (年度檢查發現安全疑慮後，設施經理終於抽空更換老舊電梯。)
The implementation team got behind schedule when two overseas shipments were delayed at the customs warehouse. (兩批海外貨件在海關倉庫延誤後，導入團隊的進度落後了。)
The new customer portal finally got off the ground after the company resolved its data migration and security issues. (公司解決資料移轉與安全問題後，新的顧客入口網站終於啟動了。)
Unclear pricing can give rise to customer complaints and repeated calls to the service center. (價格不明可能引起客訴，並讓客服中心接到重複來電。)
A clear welcome guide can go a long way toward helping new employees settle in. (清楚的歡迎指南能大大幫助新進員工適應環境。)
The project leader explained how the team would go about updating the customer database. (專案負責人說明團隊將如何著手更新客戶資料庫。)
Sharing customer records with outside vendors would go against the company’s privacy policy. (把客戶資料交給外部廠商會違反公司的隱私政策。)
The supplier agreed to go along with the revised delivery schedule after our call. (通話後，供應商同意配合修改後的配送時程。)
The vendor cannot go back on its promise to deliver the replacement units by Friday. (供應商不能違背星期五前交付替換設備的承諾。)
Despite the extra expense, the board decided to go through with the scheduled equipment upgrade. (儘管需要額外支出，董事會仍決定堅持完成預定的設備升級。)
The founder handed down several customer service principles that the staff still follows today. (創辦人傳承了幾項客服原則，員工至今仍遵循。)
Reliable delivery and clear communication go hand in hand when building long-term client relationships. (建立長期客戶關係時，可靠配送和清楚溝通密切相連。)
The board has a second location in mind if negotiations for the downtown property fall through. (如果市中心房產的協商破局，董事會已考慮好另一個地點。)
The winning proposal was head and shoulders above the alternatives because it combined lower costs with reliable support. (得標提案明顯優於其他方案，因為它兼具較低成本與可靠支援。)
The company expanded overnight monitoring to head off another outage during the upcoming billing cycle. (公司擴大夜間監控，預防下個帳務週期再次發生服務中斷。)
The company plans to invest in high tech equipment to improve production speed and reduce maintenance costs. (公司計畫投資高科技設備，以提升生產速度並降低維護成本。)
The board held fast to its disclosure policy despite pressure from investors seeking an earlier earnings announcement. (儘管投資人施壓要求提早公布財報，董事會仍堅守揭露政策。)

meaning: phr. 立場堅定；堅持不退
example: The supplier held firm on minimum order quantities after several buyers requested smaller shipments without paying higher fees. (幾位買家要求縮小出貨量卻不願支付較高費用，供應商仍堅持最低訂購量。)

meaning: phr. 表現不俗；站穩腳步
example: Despite joining the negotiation late, the junior analyst held her own while senior executives debated the pricing proposal. (儘管較晚加入談判，這位初階分析師在資深主管討論定價提案時仍表現不俗。)

meaning: phr. 站得住腳；經得起檢驗
example: The market analysis did not hold water once auditors compared its growth assumptions with actual renewal data. (稽核員將市場分析的成長假設與實際續約數據比對後，發現論點站不住腳。)
The internal review homed in on repeated approval delays rather than the minor formatting problems raised by staff. (內部檢討聚焦於一再發生的核准延誤，而非員工提出的小型格式問題。)
The company used horizontal integration to combine regional competitors and expand its distribution network efficiently. (橫向整合協助公司合併區域競爭者，並有效擴大配送網路。)
The proposed horizontal merger would unite two manufacturers serving the same market and customer base. (這項擬議中的水平合併將整合兩家服務相同市場與客群的製造商。)
Our chief negotiator is a skilled horse trader who secures favorable terms without damaging long term partnerships. (我們的首席談判代表很會精明談判，能爭取有利條件又不損害長期合作關係。)

meaning: phr. 一致同意；意見相同
example: The three regional managers were in agreement about extending the trial period before committing to a permanent vendor. (三位區域經理一致同意，先延長試用期，再決定是否與廠商簽長期合約。)

meaning: phr. 原地打轉；毫無進展
example: The planning meeting went in circles until the chair assigned clear owners to each unresolved purchasing decision. (在主席指派人員負責各項未決採購決策前，規劃會議一直原地打轉。)
The logistics and sales divisions worked in concert to reroute orders after severe weather closed two highways. (兩條高速公路因惡劣天候封閉後，物流與業務部門協力重新安排訂單路線。)
The new policy is in effect now, although some offices will receive updated forms next week. (新政策目前已生效，不過部分辦公室下週才會收到新版表格。)
In essence, the proposal asks suppliers to shorten delivery times without increasing prices. (本質上，這項提案要求供應商縮短配送時間但不提高價格。)
The updated travel policy remains in force until the board approves a replacement. (新版差旅政策會持續生效，直到董事會核准替代方案。)
The manager has the hiring process in hand and expects to make a decision by Friday. (招聘流程由經理掌控，預計星期五前做出決定。)
The revised budget is in line with the company’s spending limits for this quarter. (修訂後的預算符合公司本季的支出上限。)
In principle, employees may work remotely twice a week with their supervisor’s approval. (原則上，員工經主管核准後每週可以遠端工作兩天。)
The company will introduce the new booking system in stages across all regional offices. (公司將在所有地區辦公室分階段導入新的預約系統。)
Rumors of a possible merger were in the air, but executives had made no announcement. (合併傳聞盛傳一時，但高階主管尚未發布任何消息。)
Our downtown branch is in the lead for customer satisfaction this quarter. (本季顧客滿意度最高的是市中心分店。)
In theory, the revised route should save time, but the team will test it tomorrow. (理論上，修改後的路線應該能節省時間，但團隊明天會進行測試。)
Investigators reviewed indirect evidence from delivery records before requesting additional documents from the vendor. (調查人員先檢視送貨紀錄中的間接證據，再向供應商索取其他文件。)
The two companies are meeting this week to iron out the final contract details. (兩家公司本週會面，解決合約的最後細節問題。)
Two distributors joined forces to cover remote markets while sharing storage costs and coordinating weekly deliveries. (兩家經銷商聯手拓展偏遠市場，同時分攤倉儲費並協調每週配送。)
The inventory manager kept an eye on daily stock levels while the port strike delayed two incoming shipments. (港口罷工延誤兩批進貨期間，庫存經理密切注意每日庫存量。)

meaning: phr. 保持警覺；留意觀察
example: Keep your eyes open for unusual charges while reviewing the monthly statement from the corporate credit card. (檢視公司信用卡月結單時，請留意任何異常費用。)

meaning: phr. 阻止進入；排除在外
example: The confidentiality clause keeps outside consultants out of personnel files unless executives approve access. (除非高階主管核准，保密條款禁止外部顧問查看人事檔案。)
The review panel agreed to keep quiet about the bid results until every participating supplier received formal notice. (評審小組同意在所有投標供應商收到正式通知前，對得標結果保密。)
The coordinator keeps track of renewal dates so account managers can contact each client before coverage expires. (協調人員追蹤續約日期，讓客戶經理能在保障到期前聯絡每位客戶。)

meaning: phr. 核心幕僚；親信團隊
example: The mayor relied on a kitchen cabinet of longtime advisers before announcing the unpopular budget cuts. (市長宣布不受歡迎的預算刪減前，仰賴一群長期顧問組成的核心幕僚。)
A missed compliance certificate knocked the bidder out of consideration despite its competitive price and rapid delivery plan. (投標商雖報價具競爭力且交貨計畫迅速，仍因缺少法遵證明而遭到淘汰。)
The apprenticeship became a launch pad for employees seeking careers in project management. (學徒培訓成為員工邁向專案管理職涯的起點。)
The retailer cooperated with law enforcement after investigators linked several counterfeit orders to its warehouse. (調查人員將數筆仿冒訂單與零售商倉庫連結後，該業者配合執法。)

meaning: phr. 執法機關；執法單位
example: A law enforcement agency asked the bank to preserve account records while it reviewed the suspected fraud. (執法機關要求銀行保留帳戶紀錄，以便審查疑似詐欺案件。)

meaning: phr. 主張權利；聲稱所有
example: The software company laid claim to the patent after discovering that a former contractor had reused its design. (軟體公司發現前承包商重用了自家設計後，便主張該專利權利。)
The board laid down new approval limits to prevent regional offices from committing funds without financial review. (董事會制定新的核准額度，避免區域辦公室未經財務審查便動用資金。)
The founder laid her reputation on the line by guaranteeing refunds if the redesigned payment platform failed. (創辦人承諾若改版後的付款平台失靈就退款，等於拿自己的聲譽冒險。)
The retailer leaned on its shipping partner to restore weekend pickups after several high-value orders missed their delivery windows. (幾筆高價訂單錯過交貨時段後，零售商向物流夥伴施壓，要求恢復週末取件。)
The current meeting format does not lend itself to detailed budget discussions. (目前的會議形式不適合詳細討論預算。)
The manager asked the team to let go of the old process and test the new system. (經理請團隊放棄舊流程，測試新系統。)
The partners signed a letter of intent before negotiating the final terms of their joint venture. (雙方在協商合資案的最終條款前，先簽署了意向書。)
Our sales and support teams will link up next week to review common customer questions. (業務和客服團隊下週會連結合作，檢視常見客戶問題。)
The new model lived up to customer expectations by offering longer battery life. (新款產品提供更長的電池續航，達到顧客期待。)

meaning: phr. 遊說團體；利益團體
example: A lobby group urged lawmakers to preserve the tax credit that supports small manufacturers. (遊說團體敦促立法者保留支持小型製造商的租稅抵減。)
The merger will demand patience, and both management teams are committed for the long haul. (合併需要耐心，雙方管理團隊都已準備長期投入。)
The committee will look at each application carefully before selecting the scholarship recipient. (委員會會仔細考慮每份申請，再選出獎學金得主。)
When the main supplier is unavailable, the plant looks to a local partner for parts. (主要供應商無法供貨時，工廠會依靠當地合作夥伴提供零件。)
The team must not lose sight of its service goals while handling urgent daily requests. (處理緊急日常需求時，團隊不能忽略服務目標。)
There is no magic bullet for retaining staff; managers must improve pay, scheduling, and communication. (留住員工沒有萬靈丹，主管必須改善薪資、排班與溝通。)

meaning: phr. 郵件詐欺；郵務詐騙
example: The company warned customers about mail fraud after fake refund notices appeared in residential mailboxes. (住宅信箱出現偽造退款通知後，公司提醒客戶提防郵件詐欺。)
The director makes a point of thanking staff members who help customers after hours. (主管特別會感謝下班後協助顧客的員工。)

meaning: phr. 坦率承認；直言不諱
example: The director made no bones about the delayed rollout, explaining the risks openly during the all-staff briefing. (主管坦率承認上線延誤，在全體員工簡報中公開說明相關風險。)
Before opening another branch, the operations team mapped out staffing needs, equipment purchases, and a realistic launch timeline. (在開設新分店前，營運團隊規劃了人力需求、設備採購和可行的開幕時程。)

meaning: phr. 重大違約；實質違約
example: A material breach of the supply contract allowed the retailer to cancel future orders without penalty. (供應合約發生重大違約後，零售商得以免罰取消後續訂單。)

meaning: phr. 合併協議；併購協議
example: Both boards approved the merger agreement after lawyers resolved outstanding questions about employee benefits. (律師解決員工福利的未決問題後，雙方董事會批准了合併協議。)
The report compares mineral resources across regions before recommending locations for future investment. (報告比較各地的礦產資源，再建議未來投資地點。)
The consultant warned that unlimited reimbursement could create a moral hazard for managers approving expenses. (顧問提醒，無上限的報銷可能使核准支出的主管承受道德風險。)
Most importantly, the revised policy gives customer service agents clear authority to resolve routine billing disputes promptly. (最重要的是，新政策明確授權客服人員迅速處理一般帳務爭議。)
After legal review cleared the revised terms, both companies moved ahead with the regional distribution agreement. (法務審查確認修訂條款無誤後，兩家公司繼續推進區域經銷協議。)

meaning: phr. 完成流程；逐步處理
example: New vendor applications move through three departments before procurement issues a purchase order and confirms delivery dates. (新廠商申請會經過三個部門審核，之後採購才會下單並確認交期。)
The proposed partnership is mutually beneficial because each company gains new customers without duplicating its delivery network. (這項合作提案能互惠，因為雙方都能接觸新客戶，又不必重複建置配送網路。)
The two rebate options are mutually exclusive, so customers must choose one discount when submitting their purchase claims. (兩種回饋方案互斥，因此顧客申請購買折扣時必須擇一使用。)
The project lead nailed down a delivery date with the supplier before confirming installation appointments with each branch. (專案負責人先和供應商敲定交貨日期，再與各分店確認安裝時間。)
The hiring panel narrowed down the applicant pool to four candidates after reviewing relevant experience and client communication skills. (招募小組檢視相關經驗和客戶溝通能力後，將應徵者縮小篩選至四人。)
After the supplier raised prices unexpectedly, our quarterly sales took a nose dive across the region. (供應商突然漲價後，我們在該區的季度銷售額暴跌。)
Clear communication is of the essence when several departments share responsibility for a project. (多個部門共同負責專案時，清楚溝通至關重要。)

meaning: phr. 石油卡特爾；石油壟斷聯盟
example: The report examined how an oil cartel could influence fuel prices across several importing countries. (報告檢視石油卡特爾如何影響數個進口國的燃料價格。)
Several investors are still on the fence about funding the company’s expansion plan. (幾位投資人仍對是否資助公司的擴張計畫猶豫不決。)
The event coordinator adjusted the seating plan on the fly when more guests arrived. (更多賓客抵達時，活動協調人員臨機應變調整座位安排。)
The new location is convenient; on the other hand, its monthly rent is considerably higher. (新地點很方便；另一方面，每月租金也高出許多。)
Several options remain on the table while the two companies negotiate the service agreement. (兩家公司協商服務合約時，仍有幾個方案可供討論。)
The new inventory software is on trial in two branches before a company-wide launch. (新庫存軟體正在兩間分店試用，之後才會全面推出。)
Sharing confidential bids with competing vendors is out of bounds under the procurement policy. (依採購政策，將機密標案資料分享給競爭廠商就是越界。)
The complaint got out of hand after several inaccurate reports circulated online. (幾則不實的報導在網路上流傳後，這起客訴就失控了。)
Expanding the office this year is out of the question because the budget has been frozen. (由於預算凍結，今年不可能擴大辦公室。)
The employee chose to own up to the data entry mistake and correct the customer record. (員工選擇坦承資料輸入錯誤，並更正客戶紀錄。)
Managers should review all available evidence before they pass judgment on an employee's conduct during a customer complaint. (主管評斷員工處理客訴的行為前，應先檢視所有可取得的證據。)
The two department heads patched up their disagreement after reviewing the staffing figures and agreeing on shared coverage. (兩位部門主管檢視人力數據並同意共同支援後，化解了彼此的歧見。)
The startup filed a patent application before demonstrating its new battery design to potential investors. (新創公司在向潛在投資人展示新電池設計前，先提出專利申請。)
The supplier persisted in requesting revised forecasts until the buyer shared updated demand figures for the coming quarter. (採購方提供下季更新需求數據前，供應商持續要求修訂預測。)

meaning: phr. 製藥公司；藥品公司
example: The pharmaceutical company agreed to disclose trial results after investors questioned its reporting practices. (投資人質疑報告方式後，製藥公司同意公開試驗結果。)

meaning: phr. 逐步推行；分階段導入
example: The retailer will phase in the new returns policy over three months, giving store teams time to update their procedures. (零售商將在三個月內逐步推行新退貨政策，讓門市團隊有時間更新作業流程。)

meaning: phr. 逐步淘汰；逐步停用
example: The company plans to phase out paper purchase orders once all suppliers can access the updated procurement portal. (等所有供應商都能使用新版採購入口網站後，公司計畫逐步停用紙本採購單。)

meaning: phr. 逐一挑剔；仔細批評
example: During the budget meeting, the finance director picked apart each proposal and asked managers to support their cost estimates. (預算會議中，財務主管逐一檢視各項提案，並要求經理提出成本估算的依據。)
The analyst could not pin down the cause of the reporting error until the team compared entries from both accounting systems. (分析師比對兩套會計系統的資料後，才查明報表錯誤的原因。)

meaning: phr. 見機行事；隨機應變
example: The regional manager decided to play it by ear during the store visit, adjusting the discussion to each team's immediate concerns. (區域經理決定在巡店時見機行事，依各團隊當下的關切調整討論內容。)

meaning: phr. 繼續推進；埋頭進行
example: Despite a tight launch schedule, the project team plowed ahead after executives approved the revised budget and staffing plan. (儘管上市時程緊迫，主管核准修訂後的預算和人力計畫後，專案團隊仍繼續推進。)
The revised customer survey became the point of departure for a broader discussion about service priorities. (修訂後的客戶問卷成為討論服務優先事項的出發點。)

meaning: phr. 指引方向；指出方法
example: The customer feedback survey pointed the way toward simpler billing screens and clearer explanations of recurring charges. (客戶意見調查指出，帳單畫面應更簡潔，定期扣款說明也要更清楚。)

meaning: phr. 毒丸條款；反收購措施
example: The board adopted a poison pill to discourage a hostile takeover while it considered competing offers. (董事會採取毒丸條款以阻止惡意收購，同時評估其他收購提案。)

meaning: phr. 人氣競賽；支持度較量
example: The selection process became a popularity contest, so the committee restored its published performance criteria. (遴選過程變成了人氣競賽，因此委員會恢復採用公布的績效標準。)

meaning: phr. 權力掮客；幕後操盤者
example: The industry association’s power broker persuaded rival executives to support a shared safety standard. (產業協會的權力掮客說服競爭企業主管支持共同安全標準。)
A damaged power grid forced the regional office to postpone production until backup generators arrived. (電網受損，迫使區域辦公室延後生產，直到備用發電機送達。)

meaning: phr. 繼續努力；堅持前進
example: Even after the shipment was delayed, the event team pressed on with setup so the customer conference could open on time. (即使貨運延誤，活動團隊仍繼續準備，讓客戶研討會能準時開始。)
Emergency loans kept propping up the supplier until its largest customer resumed regular payments. (緊急貸款持續扶持這家供應商，直到最大客戶恢復正常付款。)

meaning: phr. 委託書爭奪戰；代理權之爭
example: An activist investor launched a proxy fight to replace directors who opposed selling the underperforming division. (行動派投資人發動委託書爭奪戰，試圖撤換反對出售虧損部門的董事。)

meaning: phr. 公用事業；公共服務業
example: The public utility requested approval to raise rates after documenting higher costs for maintaining aging power lines. (公用事業公司記錄老舊電線維護成本上升後，申請調漲費率。)

meaning: phr. 公用事業公司；公共服務公司
example: A public utility company must notify customers before scheduled maintenance interrupts water service. (公用事業公司在預定維護造成供水中斷前，必須通知客戶。)
The publishing company moved its regional sales team closer to the largest bookstore accounts. (這家出版公司把區域業務團隊調到更靠近最大書店客戶的地方。)
The publishing firm negotiated digital distribution rights with authors before announcing its new business imprint. (這家出版公司在宣布新品牌前，先與作者協商數位發行權。)
The publishing house expanded its translation program to reach readers in several new markets. (出版社擴大翻譯計畫，以接觸數個新市場的讀者。)

meaning: phr. 暗中運作；動用關係
example: The consultant pulled strings to arrange an urgent meeting, although the client still had to follow the formal approval process. (顧問透過人脈安排緊急會議，不過客戶仍須遵循正式核准流程。)
Executives pulled the plug on the costly renovation after updated forecasts showed that customer traffic remained below expectations. (最新預測顯示客流仍低於預期後，主管叫停了成本高昂的整修案。)
The operations director pushed through the revised safety procedures before the distribution center began its seasonal hiring. (配送中心開始季節性招募前，營運主管推動新版安全程序通過。)
The founder put her reputation on the line by promising a full refund if the new payment system failed during launch. (創辦人承諾新付款系統若在上市時故障就全額退款，等於拿自己的聲譽冒險。)

meaning: phr. 投入使用；派上用場
example: The company put the new customer database to work by using its purchase history to personalize follow-up offers. (公司利用新客戶資料庫中的購買紀錄，提供個人化後續優惠，讓資料派上用場。)
The sales coordinator put together a concise proposal combining customer feedback, revised pricing, and a six-month delivery schedule. (業務協調員整理出一份精簡提案，納入客戶意見、修訂價格和六個月配送時程。)
The analyst puzzled out why the quarterly totals differed by comparing archived reports with entries from the updated accounting system. (分析師比對封存報表和新版會計系統資料，弄清季度總額不一致的原因。)

meaning: phr. 號召口號；團結口號
example: Reliable service became the team rallying cry as managers prepared to reopen the delayed customer support line. (主管準備重啟延誤的客服專線時，可靠服務成了團隊的號召口號。)

meaning: phr. 共同目標；凝聚焦點
example: The demand for safer shifts became a rallying point for workers from departments that rarely coordinated. (要求更安全班表成了共同目標，凝聚了平時很少協調的各部門員工。)

meaning: phr. 推理得出；分析判斷
example: The compliance officer reasoned out how the missing signatures affected the contract and identified which documents needed replacement. (法遵人員分析缺少簽名對合約的影響，並找出需要重新備妥的文件。)

meaning: phr. 回收處理廠；資源回收廠
example: The manufacturer signed a supply agreement with a recycling plant to reuse scrap from its production line. (製造商與回收處理廠簽訂供應協議，重新利用生產線的廢料。)

meaning: phr. 監管機關；主管機關
example: The regulatory agency announced new disclosure rules after reviewing complaints from small business owners. (監管機關檢視小型企業主的申訴後，公布了新的資訊揭露規定。)

meaning: phr. 監管機關；主管機關
example: A regulatory authority can suspend a license when a company repeatedly violates consumer protection rules. (公司一再違反消費者保護規定時，監管機關可以暫停其執照。)
The finance director asked department heads to rein in travel spending until the company completed its midyear budget review. (財務主管要求各部門主管控制差旅支出，直到公司完成年中預算檢討。)
Branch managers rely upon the weekly inventory dashboard to spot shortages before they affect customer orders. (分店經理仰賴每週庫存儀表板，在缺貨影響客戶訂單前及早發現問題。)

meaning: phr. 再生能源產業；綠能產業
example: The renewable energy industry hired engineers as regional utilities expanded their solar and wind projects. (各地公用事業擴大太陽能與風力計畫，再生能源產業也聘用了工程師。)

meaning: phr. 可再生資源；再生能源
example: The manufacturer switched to a renewable resource for packaging after customers questioned its plastic use. (客戶質疑塑膠使用後，製造商改用可再生資源製作包裝。)

meaning: phr. 研究室；研究實驗室
example: The research lab received a grant to test a longer-lasting battery for the company's delivery fleet. (研究實驗室獲得補助，為公司的配送車隊測試續航更久的電池。)

meaning: phr. 限制競爭；貿易限制
example: The regulator warned that exclusive supplier contracts could amount to restraint of trade in a small market. (主管機關警告，獨家供應合約在小型市場中可能構成限制競爭。)
The hotel chain rode out a slow season by reducing temporary hours while keeping its experienced front desk employees. (連鎖飯店縮減臨時工時，同時留住資深櫃檯員工，順利渡過淡季。)

meaning: phr. 冒險者；敢承擔風險者
example: The risk taker backed an untested product line after reviewing customer demand and the available budget. (這位敢承擔風險的主管檢視客戶需求與可用預算後，決定支持未經測試的產品線。)

meaning: phr. 高風險投資；冒險事業
example: The partners delayed their risky venture until a market study confirmed enough demand to justify the expense. (合夥人延後這項高風險事業，直到市場研究確認需求足以支撐成本。)
The audit team rooted out duplicate vendor records that had caused repeated payment errors across several regional offices. (稽核團隊徹底查出重複的廠商資料，這些資料曾造成多個區域辦公室反覆付款錯誤。)
We run a risk of losing the client if we delay the revised proposal again. (如果再次延遲修訂提案，我們就冒著失去客戶的風險。)
The renovation project ran into unexpected delays after several building permits were held up. (幾張建築許可延遲後，整修專案遇到意外的進度問題。)
The company will scale down its regional advertising campaign after reviewing quarterly sales. (檢視季度銷售後，公司將縮減區域廣告活動規模。)
If customer demand remains strong, the manufacturer can scale up production next month. (如果顧客需求持續強勁，製造商下個月可以擴大產量。)

meaning: phr. 不記名投票；秘密投票
example: Staff chose their employee representative by secret ballot after management agreed to publish the final tally. (管理層同意公布最終票數後，員工以不記名投票選出代表。)
The regional director and store manager finally saw eye to eye on the revised staffing plan. (區域主管和店長終於對修訂後的人力計畫看法一致。)
Please see to it that every customer receives an updated receipt before leaving. (請確保每位顧客離開前都拿到更新後的收據。)
A shared calendar serves the team well by keeping deadlines visible to everyone. (共用行事曆讓所有人都能看到期限，對團隊很有幫助。)
The staff set about preparing the conference rooms as soon as the final schedule arrived. (最終時程一到，員工就著手準備會議室。)
A delay in receiving permits set back the opening of the new service center. (許可證延遲送達，使新服務中心的開幕時間延後。)
The board’s approval set in motion the final phase of the office relocation. (董事會核准後，辦公室搬遷的最後階段正式啟動。)
The seating plan is not set in stone, so guests can still request adjustments. (座位安排尚未定案不變，賓客仍可提出調整需求。)
The announcement set off a series of questions from employees about the schedule change. (公告引發員工對時程變更的一連串疑問。)
The company plans to shake up its management structure after completing the acquisition. (公司計畫在完成收購後大幅改組管理架構。)
The sales results are beginning to shape up after the team changed its outreach strategy. (團隊調整推廣策略後，銷售成果開始有起色。)
The audit findings shed light on why regional offices were missing their quarterly service targets. (稽核結果闡明各區辦公室未達季度服務目標的原因。)
The department will shoot for a ten percent reduction in processing time during the next reporting cycle. (部門將力爭在下一個報告週期內縮短百分之十的處理時間。)
Management introduced mentoring sessions to shore up morale after two difficult rounds of organizational restructuring. (經歷兩輪艱難的組織改組後，管理層推出導師會談以提振士氣。)
The new supervisor did not shrink from difficult conversations when the project team missed its agreed deadlines. (專案團隊未能遵守期限時，新任主管並未逃避艱難的談話。)
Several board members sided with the finance chief after she presented evidence of the project’s rising costs. (財務主管提出專案成本上升的證據後，幾名董事支持她的立場。)
Before extending the contract, procurement sized up the supplier’s delivery record, financial stability, and support capacity. (延長合約前，採購部評估供應商的交貨紀錄、財務穩定性與支援能力。)

meaning: phr. 輕描淡寫；避而不談
example: The manager skated over the missed targets in her presentation, prompting the board to request a fuller explanation. (主管在簡報中對未達標一事輕描淡寫，董事會因此要求更完整的說明。)
The project leads met twice to smooth out approval delays before the new reporting process went live. (新回報流程上線前，專案主管開了兩次會排除核准延誤。)
A minor billing error sparked off a wider review of how customer refunds were processed across all branches. (一筆小額帳單錯誤引發更全面的檢討，查核各分店的客戶退款流程。)
The technology group spun off its payment division, allowing the new company to focus on independent growth and partnerships. (科技集團分拆付款部門，讓新公司能專注於獨立成長和合作夥伴關係。)

meaning: phr. 妥善處理；安排妥當
example: The event coordinator squared away the venue permits and equipment bookings several days before the annual customer conference. (活動協調員在年度客戶研討會前幾天，就妥善辦好場地許可和設備預約。)

meaning: phr. 施壓手段；強勢逼迫
example: The supplier used a squeeze play, threatening to delay shipments unless the buyer accepted an immediate price increase. (供應商採取施壓手段，威脅延遲出貨，除非買方立即接受漲價。)
The compliance team introduced anonymous reporting to stamp out repeated conflicts of interest in vendor selection. (法遵團隊設立匿名通報管道，以杜絕廠商遴選中的利益衝突。)
The purchasing director stood firm on the quality requirements despite pressure to approve a cheaper substitute from the supplier. (儘管供應商施壓要求核准較便宜的替代品，採購主管仍堅守品質要求。)
Two former colleagues started up a consulting firm that helps small retailers improve inventory planning and customer retention. (兩名前同事創立了一家顧問公司，協助小型零售商改善庫存規劃和客戶留存。)

meaning: phr. 訴訟時效；追訴期限
example: Counsel reviewed the statute of limitations before advising the company whether it could pursue the former distributor. (律師在建議公司是否追究前經銷商責任前，先檢視訴訟時效。)
The implementation guide explains step by step how branch managers should transfer customer records to the new booking platform. (導入指南逐步說明分店經理如何將客戶資料轉移到新的預約平台。)
The customer service supervisor stepped in when a billing dispute remained unresolved after several exchanges with the vendor. (與廠商多次聯繫仍無法解決帳務爭議時，客服主管出面處理。)
The retailer stepped up fraud monitoring after several customers reported unauthorized purchases on their loyalty accounts. (幾位顧客通報會員帳戶出現未授權消費後，零售商加強了詐欺監控。)
To avoid extra charges, the contractor agreed to stick to the delivery schedule listed in the signed service agreement. (為避免額外費用，承包商同意遵守已簽署服務協議所列的交貨時程。)
After testing several scheduling tools, the branch supervisors decided to stick with the current system until the busy season ended. (測試幾種排班工具後，分店主管決定在旺季結束前繼續使用現行系統。)
The strategic buyout gave the manufacturer access to patents and distribution channels it had lacked for years. (這項策略性收購讓製造商取得多年來欠缺的專利與通路。)
The appeals panel struck down the fee increase because the notice had not been provided to customers within the required period. (申訴小組撤銷了費用調漲，因為公司未在規定期限內通知客戶。)
The registrar struck off inactive vendors after procurement confirmed that none had submitted current insurance documents. (採購部確認廠商都未提交有效保險文件後，登記人員將未合作廠商除名。)
The subsidiary company will retain its local brand while sharing procurement services with the parent organization. (這家子公司會保留當地品牌，同時與母公司共用採購服務。)

meaning: phr. 監視系統；監控系統
example: The hotel upgraded its surveillance system after guests reported repeated thefts from the underground parking area. (住客多次通報地下停車場失竊後，飯店升級了監視系統。)
The company must address the safety complaint openly instead of sweeping it under the rug. (公司必須公開處理安全客訴，而不是掩蓋問題。)
The director took a firm stand against sharing customer data without written consent. (主管堅定表態，反對未取得書面同意就分享顧客資料。)
After the previous supervisor retired, Elena took charge of the regional office. (前任主管退休後，Elena 接手負責地區辦公室。)
Please take the client’s delivery requirements into account when choosing a shipping company. (選擇貨運公司時，請把客戶的配送需求納入考量。)
Several board members took issue with the proposed increase in annual travel spending. (幾位董事對提高年度差旅支出的提案提出異議。)
The revised marketing plan began to take shape after customer survey results arrived. (收到顧客調查結果後，修訂版行銷計畫逐漸成形。)
At the end of the quarter, managers take stock of sales and staffing needs. (季末時，經理會盤點評估銷售和人力需求。)
The committee will take up the parking issue at its next monthly meeting. (委員會將在下次月會著手處理停車問題。)

meaning: phr. 收購企圖；接管企圖
example: The board rejected a takeover attempt that offered shareholders a premium but threatened long-term research plans. (董事會拒絕一項收購企圖；該提案雖溢價收購，卻威脅長期研究計畫。)

meaning: phr. 收購要約；收購提案
example: The firm received a takeover bid from a competitor and asked advisers to assess its financing and regulatory risks. (公司收到競爭對手的收購提案，並請顧問評估融資與法規風險。)

meaning: phr. 收購目標；併購標的
example: The board identified a takeover target after reviewing its customer base, debt, and regional market share. (董事會檢視客戶群、債務與區域市占率後，選定了一家收購目標。)
The supervisor talked the hesitant employee into attending the customer service workshop. (主管說服原本猶豫的員工參加客服工作坊。)
Her colleagues talked her out of sending an angry reply to the supplier. (同事勸她不要寄出回覆供應商的氣話。)
The buyer and supplier will talk terms after reviewing the updated delivery schedule. (買方和供應商檢視更新後的配送時程，再協商條件。)
The sales and design departments teamed up to prepare a presentation for the trade show. (業務部和設計部組隊合作，準備商展簡報。)
Before renewing the contract, the purchasing manager thought about how changing delivery terms might affect the branches. (續約前，採購經理考慮了變更交貨條件可能對各分店造成的影響。)

meaning: phr. 仔細思考；周詳考慮
example: The product team thought out a transition plan that kept customer accounts active while the payment platform was replaced. (產品團隊周詳考慮了一套轉換計畫，確保更換付款平台時客戶帳戶仍可使用。)
The marketing assistant thought up a loyalty promotion that rewarded repeat customers without reducing the store's usual margins. (行銷助理構思了一項回饋活動，獎勵回購客戶又不降低商店平常的利潤。)

meaning: phr. 草率拼湊；匆忙準備
example: The regional office threw together a brief response for the press while executives prepared a fuller statement about the service outage. (主管準備完整的服務中斷聲明時，區域辦公室先匆忙擬了一份簡短媒體回覆。)

meaning: phr. 潛在危機；定時炸彈
example: Unpaid maintenance bills had become a ticking bomb for the hotel before the busy holiday season. (繁忙假期前，未付的維修帳單已成為飯店的潛在危機。)
The office administrator tidied up the vendor files before the audit, removing duplicate forms and labeling the current insurance certificates. (稽核前，行政人員整理廠商檔案、移除重複表單，並標示有效的保險證明。)
The communications team tied the announcement in with the retailer's seasonal campaign to reach customers through several channels. (溝通團隊將公告配合零售商的季節活動，透過多種管道接觸客戶。)
The finance department tightened up expense approvals after discovering that several teams had exceeded their quarterly travel budgets. (財務部發現幾個團隊超出季度差旅預算後，加強了費用核准管控。)

meaning: phr. 暗中通報；事先告知
example: An employee tipped off the compliance officer about a vendor offering personal gifts during a competitive bidding process. (有員工暗中通報法遵人員，某廠商在公開競標期間提供私人禮品。)
The redesigned customer portal is, to all intents and purposes, ready for launch, pending final approval from information security. (新版客戶入口網站實際上已準備就緒，只待資訊安全部門最後核准即可上線。)

meaning: phr. 一字不差；嚴格遵照
example: The technician followed the installation checklist to the letter to preserve the equipment warranty and meet the client's safety requirements. (技術人員嚴格遵照安裝檢查表操作，以維持設備保固並符合客戶的安全要求。)
The department head topped off the quarterly review by confirming owners and deadlines for every outstanding action item. (部門主管確認每項待辦事項的負責人和期限，為季度檢討會收尾。)
Management floated a trial balloon about changing office hours before announcing a formal policy. (管理層正式公布政策前，先試探大家對調整辦公時間的反應。)

meaning: phr. 視而不見；睜一隻眼閉一隻眼
example: Managers cannot turn a blind eye to repeated safety violations, even when the production schedule is under pressure. (即使生產時程緊迫，主管也不能對一再發生的安全違規視而不見。)

meaning: phr. 扭轉局勢；改變趨勢
example: Improved response times helped turn the tide after online complaints had begun to damage the company's customer ratings. (網路客訴開始損害公司的客戶評分後，縮短回覆時間有助於扭轉局勢。)

meaning: phr. 加大壓力；提高要求
example: The distributor turned up the heat during negotiations by requesting shorter payment terms and lower minimum order quantities. (經銷商在談判中要求縮短付款期限並降低最低訂購量，以加大壓力。)

meaning: phr. 加大壓力；施加更大壓力
example: The client turned up the pressure when the contractor missed another milestone and failed to explain the revised completion date. (承包商再次錯過里程碑且未說明修訂後的完工日期，客戶因此加大壓力。)

meaning: phr. 遭受抨擊；受到攻擊
example: The pricing policy came under attack from small retailers who said the new fees would make online orders less competitive. (小型零售商抨擊這項定價政策，認為新費用會削弱網路訂單的競爭力。)

meaning: phr. 受到批評；遭受責難
example: The company came under fire after customers discovered that its advertised discount excluded several popular products. (顧客發現廣告折扣不適用於幾項熱門商品後，公司受到批評。)
Renovation work is under way at the downtown branch, so customers should use the temporary entrance beside the parking lot. (市中心分店正在整修，顧客請改走停車場旁的臨時入口。)

meaning: phr. 尚未確定；懸而未決
example: The final delivery date is still up in the air because customs has not approved the revised documents from the supplier. (海關尚未核准供應商修訂後的文件，因此最終交貨日期仍未確定。)
The city approved an urban renewal plan that will add apartments, shops, and a public park. (市府核准都市更新計畫，將增建公寓、商店和公園。)

meaning: phr. 垂直整合；垂直併購
example: Vertical integration gave the manufacturer tighter control over components, distribution schedules, and supplier quality. (垂直整合讓製造商更能掌控零組件、配送時程與供應商品質。)

meaning: phr. 既得利益；切身利益
example: Several executives had a vested interest in keeping the outdated contract because it guaranteed annual bonuses. (幾位主管有切身利益，希望保留那份能保障年終獎金的舊合約。)
Customers viewed the extended warranty as valuable because it covered repairs after the standard protection period expired. (顧客認為延長保固很有價值，因為它涵蓋標準保障期結束後的維修。)
Shareholders voted down the proposed merger after reviewing concerns about debt levels and the planned closure of two regional offices. (股東檢視負債和關閉兩處區域辦公室的疑慮後，投票否決了合併案。)

meaning: phr. 投票罷免；投票撤換
example: Members voted out the committee chair after an independent review found repeated failures to disclose conflicts of interest. (獨立審查發現多次未揭露利益衝突後，會員投票撤換了委員會主席。)
The buyer walked away from negotiations when the supplier refused to honor the written quote or explain the additional fees. (供應商拒絕遵守書面報價，也不說明額外費用後，買方退出談判。)
