The retailer added two-factor verification to ward off account fraud after several customers reported suspicious password reset requests. (幾位顧客通報可疑的密碼重設要求後，零售商新增雙重驗證以防止帳戶詐欺。)

meaning: phr. 撇清責任；不再過問
example: After approving the vendor list, the director could not wash her hands of the procurement problems that followed. (核准廠商名單後，主管不能對接踵而來的採購問題撇清責任。)

meaning: phr. 節約用水；水資源保育
example: The hotel adopted water conservation measures after summer demand strained the municipal supply. (夏季用水需求讓市府供水吃緊後，飯店採取了節約用水措施。)
The committee watered down the proposal after small business owners objected to its costly reporting requirements. (小型企業業主反對昂貴的申報要求後，委員會削弱了提案內容。)

meaning: phr. 深思熟慮；周詳規劃
example: The board approved a well thought out succession plan that prepared two internal candidates for future leadership roles. (董事會核准周詳的接班計畫，培養兩位內部人選接任未來領導職務。)
A well timed reminder reached customers just before their annual service agreements expired, helping the account team renew several contracts. (一則時機恰當的提醒在年度服務合約到期前送達，協助客戶團隊續約了幾份合約。)
The unused convention center became a white elephant that drained the city’s maintenance budget. (閒置的會議中心成了昂貴累贅，持續耗掉市府的維護預算。)

meaning: phr. 風力發電機；風力發電設備
example: The wind generator supplied backup power to the coastal warehouse after fuel deliveries were delayed. (燃料延遲送達後，風力發電設備為沿海倉庫提供備用電力。)
The planning group worked out a practical schedule that accommodates all three departments. (規劃小組想出一套可配合三個部門的實際時程。)
The auction house listed the office furniture online and scheduled a public sale after several businesses requested viewings. (幾家企業要求看貨後，拍賣行將辦公家具上架，並安排公開拍賣。)

meaning: phr. 公開拍賣；拍賣出售
example: The auction sale attracted several local retailers who were seeking display cases and office furnishings at lower prices. (公開拍賣吸引幾家當地零售商前來尋找價格較低的展示櫃和辦公家具。)
The auto company announced a new compact model designed to reduce fuel costs for customers who commute between nearby cities. (汽車公司宣布推出新款小型車，為往返鄰近城市通勤的顧客降低燃油成本。)
The auto manufacturer recalled several vehicles after technicians found a defect in the braking system during routine inspections. (技術人員例行檢查時發現煞車系統有瑕疵後，汽車製造商召回了數輛車。)
The purchasing manager bargained down the supplier’s initial quote by negotiating a larger order. (採購經理透過協商增加訂單，成功壓低供應商的初始報價。)
The guidebook became a best seller after the publisher promoted it at the travel fair. (出版社在旅展推廣後，這本指南成為暢銷書。)

meaning: phr. 大量郵件；大宗郵寄
example: The retailer used bulk mail to announce its warehouse sale to customers who had not subscribed to electronic promotions. (零售商以大量郵件通知未訂閱電子促銷的顧客，告知倉庫特賣資訊。)
Several offices buy at the local cooperative because it offers reliable produce and consolidated monthly billing. (幾間辦公室都向當地合作社採購，因為它提供穩定的生鮮商品與合併月結帳單。)

meaning: phr. 口耳相傳；口碑傳播
example: The neighborhood café gained most of its office catering customers by word of mouth rather than paid advertising. (這家社區咖啡館的大多數辦公室餐飲客戶，都是透過口耳相傳而來，並非付費廣告。)
Several retailers tried to cash in on the festival by offering limited bundles and extended evening shopping hours. (幾家零售商推出限量組合與延長晚間營業，試圖利用節慶商機獲利。)
The local chamber of commerce organized a networking event that connected restaurant owners with regional food suppliers. (當地商會舉辦交流活動，讓餐廳業主與區域食品供應商建立聯繫。)
The store manager opened another checkout counter when the evening rush created a long line near the entrance. (傍晚人潮在入口附近排起長隊時，店長增開了一個結帳櫃檯。)

meaning: phr. 結帳隊伍；收銀排隊
example: A cashier called for additional staff after the checkout line stretched beyond the seasonal display near the front doors. (結帳隊伍排到入口旁的季節商品展示區後，收銀員呼叫更多人手支援。)
The marketing assistant added clip art to the internal newsletter, then checked that every image remained readable when printed. (行銷助理在內部電子報加入美工圖庫圖片，並確認列印後每張圖仍清晰可辨。)
Customer demand came back after the retailer restored weekend delivery and extended its return window. (零售商恢復週末配送並延長退貨期限後，顧客需求回升了。)
Fuel surcharges came down after the carrier renegotiated its routes and consolidated several regional shipments. (承運商重新協商航線並整併數批區域貨運後，燃油附加費降低了。)
The annual service plan comes with onsite maintenance and replacement parts for equipment failures reported within twelve months. (年度服務方案附帶現場維護，並提供十二個月內通報的設備故障替換零件。)
The retailer imports consumer goods from several countries to offer customers more choices. (零售商從多個國家進口消費品，提供顧客更多選擇。)
The new supplier delivered the goods on time and met every quality requirement. (新供應商如期交貨，並符合所有品質要求。)
The company added an online distribution channel to reach customers outside major cities. (公司新增線上銷售通路，以接觸主要城市以外的顧客。)

meaning: phr. 充分展現；適當呈現
example: The product photographs do justice to the new fabric range by showing its texture under natural light. (產品照片以自然光呈現新布料系列的質感，充分展現了商品特色。)
The retailer hired a local agency to drum up interest in its new online ordering service before launch. (零售商聘請當地代理商，在新線上訂購服務上線前招徠顧客關注。)
The editorial department reviewed the article and confirmed the publication date with the advertiser. (編輯部審閱文章後，向廣告客戶確認了刊登日期。)
The event planner confirmed catering, seating, and transportation for the company annual meeting. (活動企劃師確認了公司年會的餐飲、座位安排與交通。)
The new service received a favorable reception from customers during its first month on the market. (新服務上市首月獲得顧客熱烈好評。)

meaning: phr. 取得進展；擴大優勢
example: The regional brand gained ground after retailers expanded its shelf space and promoted the new product range. (零售商擴大陳列空間並推廣新系列後，這個區域品牌逐漸取得優勢。)
The store will give away reusable bags to the first fifty customers on Saturday. (商店星期六會贈送環保袋給前五十位顧客。)
The agency revised the graphic design for the product brochure before sending it to the printer. (代理商在產品手冊送印前修改了平面設計。)
Our graphic designer prepared updated packaging artwork for the seasonal product launch. (我們的平面設計師為季節性產品上市準備了新版包裝圖稿。)
The company mailed its quarterly house organ to employees and major customers with updates about new services. (公司寄出季度企業刊物給員工與主要客戶，介紹新服務的最新消息。)
The agency jazzed up the campaign with customer stories and clearer product images before the holiday launch. (假期上市前，代理商加入顧客故事與更清楚的產品圖片，讓宣傳活動更生動。)

meaning: phr. 降低價格；大幅減價
example: The supplier knocked down its quoted price after the retailer committed to a larger annual order. (零售商承諾提高年度訂購量後，供應商降低了報價。)
The retailer expanded its line of merchandise to include reusable containers and travel accessories. (零售商擴充商品系列，加入可重複使用的容器與旅行配件。)
The retailer marked down winter coats after reviewing inventory levels, helping clear shelf space for the spring collection. (零售商檢視庫存後調降冬季外套價格，騰出空間陳列春季系列。)

meaning: phr. 媒體顧問；傳播顧問
example: The media consultant advised the nonprofit on choosing channels for its public health campaign. (媒體顧問協助非營利組織挑選公共衛生活動的宣傳管道。)
The communications manager sent the product announcement to local news media before the public launch. (公關經理在產品公開上市前，將消息發布給當地新聞媒體。)
The spokesperson played down the service interruption, while the company prepared a detailed explanation for affected customers. (發言人淡化服務中斷的影響，公司則準備向受影響客戶提出詳細說明。)

meaning: phr. 典型代表；宣傳象徵
example: The startup became a poster child for sustainable packaging after retailers adopted its refill system. (零售商採用這家新創的補充包系統後，它成了永續包裝的典型代表。)

meaning: phr. 報刊剪報；媒體剪報
example: The public relations team attached a press clipping to its monthly report on the product launch. (公關團隊在產品上市的月報中，附上一則媒體剪報。)

meaning: phr. 價格區間；價位範圍
example: Marketing compared conversion rates across each price bracket before revising the product’s launch campaign. (行銷團隊修訂產品上市活動前，先比較各價格區間的轉換率。)
The retailer lowered the price tag on older models before introducing its updated equipment line. (零售商推出更新款設備前，先調降舊款的標價。)

meaning: phr. 印刷媒體；紙本媒體
example: The agency shifted part of its advertising budget from print media to carefully targeted newsletters. (代理商把部分廣告預算從印刷媒體轉到精準鎖定的電子報。)
The sales team updated promotional material before presenting the new service at the regional trade show. (業務團隊在區域商展介紹新服務前更新了宣傳資料。)
The retailer pulled ahead of competitors after expanding same-day delivery and improving its online order tracking tools. (零售商擴大當日配送並改善線上訂單追蹤工具後，逐漸領先競爭對手。)

meaning: phr. 房地產經紀人；房仲
example: The real estate broker arranged a morning viewing after confirming the buyer's financing with the bank. (確認買方的銀行融資後，房仲安排了上午看屋。)

meaning: phr. 大量湧入；接連到來
example: After the product review went viral, online orders rolled in faster than the fulfillment center could prepare outgoing packages. (產品評論爆紅後，網路訂單大量湧入，出貨中心來不及包裝寄出。)
The company opened a sales outlet near the airport to serve business travelers arriving after regular office hours. (公司在機場附近開設銷售據點，服務一般辦公時間後抵達的商務旅客。)
The store will sell off last season’s furniture to make room for the new collection. (商店將折價售出上一季的家具，騰出空間擺放新品。)
The concert tickets sold out quickly after the company shared the presale link. (公司分享預售連結後，演唱會門票很快售罄。)
Online inquiries shot up after the company announced its expanded warranty and faster delivery options. (公司宣布延長保固並加快配送後，線上詢問量急遽上升。)
Many employees shop at the company store because it offers dependable supplies at discounted prices. (許多員工在公司商店購物，因為那裡提供可靠且折扣優惠的用品。)

meaning: phr. 購物中心；大型商場
example: The company opened a service kiosk inside the shopping mall to reach weekend customers. (公司在購物中心內開設服務櫃檯，接觸週末前來的顧客。)

meaning: phr. 迅速搶購；搶先取得
example: Customers snapped up the discounted conference passes within hours, prompting organizers to open another registration block. (顧客在數小時內搶購折扣會議票，主辦方因此加開另一批名額。)

meaning: phr. 社群媒體；社交媒體
example: The marketing team answered customer complaints on social media before the product launch. (產品上市前，行銷團隊在社群媒體上回覆了顧客抱怨。)
The retailer moved soft goods closer to checkout after reviewing seasonal sales data. (零售商檢視季節銷售資料後，把服飾用品移到更靠近結帳處的位置。)
The retailer opened a specialty store downtown to showcase locally designed products and attract business travelers. (零售商在市中心開設專賣店，展示本地設計商品並吸引商務旅客。)
The promotional campaign stirred up interest among local businesses by highlighting the new service's faster processing times. (促銷活動強調新服務處理速度更快，成功引起當地企業的興趣。)

meaning: phr. 沿街商場；帶狀商場
example: The franchise opened a branch in the strip mall because nearby offices brought steady weekday customers. (這家連鎖店在沿街商場開設分店，因為附近辦公室帶來穩定的平日客流。)
Customers can take advantage of the discount by ordering through the website before Friday. (顧客可在星期五前透過網站訂購，善加利用這項折扣。)
The restaurant can take orders by phone until ten minutes before closing time. (餐廳可在打烊前十分鐘停止電話接單。)
To close the bulk order, the supplier threw in free setup support and waived the usual fee for staff orientation. (為了成交大量訂單，供應商附送免費設定支援，並免除一般員工訓練費。)

meaning: phr. 折價換購；以舊換新
example: Customers can trade in older office printers toward the purchase of a more energy-efficient model during the summer promotion. (夏季促銷期間，顧客可用舊型辦公室印表機折價換購更省電的機種。)
The traveling salesman visits three regional offices each week to meet existing customers. (這位外勤業務每週拜訪三個地區辦公室，與現有客戶會面。)
The catalog uses true to life product photos so customers can compare the fabric colors before placing an online order. (型錄使用逼真的產品照片，讓顧客線上訂購前能比較布料顏色。)

meaning: phr. 扭轉局勢；反敗為勝
example: The regional sales team turned the tables by offering faster installation and clearer service guarantees than its competitors. (區域業務團隊提供更快的安裝和更明確的服務保證，成功扭轉競爭局勢。)

meaning: phr. 虛擬實境；虛擬實境技術
example: Retailers tested virtual reality displays to let customers preview furniture in their homes. (零售商測試虛擬實境展示，讓顧客預覽家具擺在家中的樣子。)
The representative won over the client by explaining the product’s long-term savings. (業務代表說明產品長期省錢效益，成功說服客戶。)

meaning: phr. 葡萄酒商；酒類經銷商
example: The wine merchant offered volume discounts to restaurants ordering cases for the holiday season. (葡萄酒商為訂購節慶用整箱酒款的餐廳提供大量採購折扣。)
Freight charges account for nearly one fifth of the supplier's total distribution expenses this year. (運費占了這家供應商今年總配送支出的近五分之一。)
Please send supplier invoices to accounts payable before the monthly closing date. (請在月結日前將供應商發票送交應付帳款部門。)
The accounting team reviews accounts receivable weekly and contacts clients with overdue balances. (會計團隊每週檢視應收帳款，並聯絡逾期未付款客戶。)
The unexplained charges did not add up, so the accountant requested a corrected invoice from the supplier. (那些無法說明的費用兜不起來，因此會計人員向供應商索取更正後的發票。)
All told, the renovation cost less than expected because the contractor reused several serviceable fixtures. (總計來看，承包商重複使用數件堪用設備，讓整修費低於預期。)

meaning: phr. 備抵帳戶；預備帳戶
example: The controller reviewed the allowance account each quarter to ensure that expected customer defaults were reflected in the financial statements. (主計長每季檢視備抵帳戶，確保財報反映預期的客戶違約金額。)

meaning: phr. 更正申報；修正稅表
example: The accountant filed an amended return after discovering that the company's original tax form omitted a major equipment purchase. (會計師發現公司原始稅表漏列一筆大型設備採購後，提交了更正申報。)
The company will auction off unused office equipment and donate the proceeds to charity. (公司會拍賣閒置辦公設備，並將所得捐給慈善機構。)

meaning: phr. 經查核帳戶；已稽核帳目
example: The lender requested an audited account before approving the company's application for an expanded revolving credit facility. (貸款機構核准公司提高循環信用額度前，要求提供經查核的帳戶資料。)

meaning: phr. 核准股數；授權股份
example: The corporate secretary verified the number of authorized shares before preparing documents for the upcoming shareholder vote. (公司秘書在準備即將舉行的股東投票文件前，確認了核准股數。)
The bank offered an auto loan with fixed monthly payments to customers purchasing vehicles through its partner dealerships. (銀行為透過合作經銷商購車的顧客提供每月固定還款的汽車貸款。)
You can withdraw cash from the automatic teller machine beside the hotel lobby. (您可以在飯店大廳旁的自動提款機領取現金。)
The rental company requires proof of automobile insurance before releasing the vehicle. (租車公司交車前要求提供汽車保險證明。)
Customers can apply for an automobile loan through the bank’s online service. (顧客可以透過銀行線上服務申請汽車貸款。)
Over the full quarter, the weekly shipping costs average out to about eight hundred dollars. (整季平均下來，每週運費約為八百美元。)
The parent company agreed to bail out the local branch after sales fell sharply. (銷售大幅下滑後，母公司同意為當地分公司紓困。)
The bank withdrawal appeared on the account statement the following business day. (銀行提款紀錄在下一個工作日出現在帳戶明細上。)
The board did not give the contractor a blank check to spend beyond the approved budget. (董事會沒有授權承包商不受限制地超出核准預算支出。)
The investor kept the bond certificate with other documents related to the company’s portfolio. (投資人將債券憑證和其他投資組合文件一同保存。)
Analysts believe regional demand will bottom out before manufacturers begin rebuilding inventories next spring. (分析師認為，區域需求將在製造商明年春天重建庫存前觸底。)

meaning: phr. 收支平衡；不賺不賠
example: The new branch must serve forty customers daily to break even on rent, utilities, and staffing costs. (新分店每天須服務四十位顧客，才能打平租金、水電及人事成本。)
A short-term credit line helped bridge over the cash-flow gap until the delayed client payment arrived. (短期信用額度填補了現金流空缺，直到延遲的客戶款項入帳。)

meaning: phr. 證券帳戶；經紀帳戶
example: The investor transferred funds into a brokerage account before purchasing shares recommended by her financial adviser. (投資人先將資金轉入證券帳戶，再購買財務顧問推薦的股票。)

meaning: phr. 證券經紀公司；券商
example: The brokerage firm assigned a new adviser to clients whose previous representative had retired earlier this month. (原負責代表本月初退休後，證券公司為其客戶指派了新的顧問。)

meaning: phr. 編列預算；預留經費
example: The department budgeted for two additional translators to handle the product launch materials and customer inquiries. (部門編列預算增聘兩名譯者，處理產品上市資料與客戶詢問。)
The retailer built up emergency stock before the port strike threatened deliveries from its main supplier. (港口罷工威脅主要供應商的交貨前，零售商已逐步增加緊急庫存。)

meaning: phr. 多頭市場；股市看漲
example: During a bull market, the investment firm expanded its research team to serve clients seeking new opportunities. (多頭市場期間，投資公司擴編研究團隊，服務尋找新機會的客戶。)

meaning: phr. 營業費用扣除；商業扣抵
example: The accountant checked each business deduction against receipts before preparing the owner's annual tax return. (會計師準備業主年度報稅資料前，先逐項核對營業費用扣除是否有收據佐證。)
The board authorized the company to buy back shares after reviewing cash reserves and the planned equipment upgrades. (董事會檢視現金儲備與設備升級計畫後，授權公司買回股票。)

meaning: phr. 買進股份；投資入股
example: The pension fund plans to buy into the regional utility after reviewing its earnings and long-term infrastructure needs. (退休基金檢視該區域公用事業公司的獲利與長期基礎建設需求後，計畫投資入股。)

meaning: phr. 收購出價；收購要約
example: The board reviewed a buyout bid from a competitor before deciding whether to negotiate or continue operating independently. (董事會先審議競爭對手提出的收購要約，再決定談判或維持獨立營運。)
The company reports its annual results by calendar year, while several overseas branches follow different fiscal schedules. (公司按曆年公布年度成果，但幾個海外分支機構採用不同的會計年度。)
Savings from bulk shipping may cancel out the extra handling fees charged by the new distribution partner. (大量運送的節省金額可能抵銷新配送夥伴收取的額外處理費。)
The accounting team will carry forward unused credits to next quarter under the revised tax reporting policy. (依照修訂後的稅務申報政策，會計團隊會將未用抵免額結轉至下季。)

meaning: phr. 定期存單；存款證明
example: The customer opened a certificate of deposit with the bank and agreed to leave the funds untouched for twelve months. (顧客在銀行開立定期存單，並同意十二個月內不動用這筆資金。)

meaning: phr. 保付支票；保證支票
example: The property manager requested a certified check for the security deposit before handing the new tenant the apartment keys. (物業經理在交付新房客鑰匙前，要求對方支付保付支票作為押金。)

meaning: phr. 執業會計師；註冊會計師
example: The certified public accountant reviewed the company's annual statements and explained several tax adjustments to its directors. (執業會計師審查公司的年度報表，並向董事說明幾項稅務調整。)

meaning: phr. 慈善信託；公益信託
example: The foundation established a charitable trust to fund job training for adults returning to work after extended career breaks. (基金會設立慈善信託，資助長期離職後重返職場的成年人接受職業訓練。)
Several department heads chipped in to fund a farewell reception for the retiring regional director. (幾位部門主管共同出資，為即將退休的區域主管舉辦歡送會。)
The finance department will close out the quarter after reconciling outstanding invoices and confirming all expense reports. (財務部核對未付款發票並確認所有費用報告後，便會完成本季結帳。)
The updated warranty terms are comparable to those offered by larger manufacturers, despite the company's smaller service network. (儘管服務網路較小，這家公司的新版保固條款仍可與大型製造商相比。)
The auditor asked the finance team to disclose any contingent liability related to the lawsuit. (稽核人員要求財務團隊揭露任何與訴訟相關的或有負債。)
The startup issued a convertible bond to raise funds while delaying its stock offering. (新創公司發行可轉換債券籌資，同時延後股票發行。)
The cost accountant reviewed factory expenses before management approved the new production budget. (管理層核准新的生產預算前，成本會計師先檢視了工廠費用。)
The controller updated the cost ledger with labor and material expenses from each department. (主計長將各部門的勞務與材料費用更新至成本分類帳。)
Investors purchased a coupon bond that pays interest twice each year until maturity. (投資人購買了一種每年支付兩次利息、到期償還的息票債券。)
During the credit crunch, several small businesses struggled to secure loans for expansion. (信貸緊縮期間，幾家小企業難以取得擴張所需的貸款。)
The company issued cumulative preferred stock to attract investors seeking predictable dividend payments. (公司發行累積特別股，吸引尋求穩定股利的投資人。)
The broker explained how securities traded on the curb market differ from listed stocks. (經紀人說明了場外市場交易的證券與上市股票有何不同。)
The analyst linked the cyclical deficit to lower tax receipts during the recent economic slowdown. (分析師將週期性赤字歸因於近期經濟放緩期間稅收減少。)
The bookkeeper investigated the debit balance before closing the customer account for the quarter. (簿記員在季度結帳前調查了該客戶帳戶的借方餘額。)
The accountant recorded the debit entry in the ledger and attached the supplier receipt. (會計師將借方分錄記入分類帳，並附上供應商收據。)
The payment appeared on the debit side of the statement after the bank processed the transfer. (銀行處理轉帳後，這筆付款出現在對帳單的借方欄。)
Lawmakers debated raising the debt ceiling before the government reached its borrowing limit. (政府借款即將觸及上限前，立法者辯論是否提高債務上限。)
The freelancer filed a declaration of estimated tax before the quarterly payment deadline. (自由工作者在季度繳款期限前提交了預估稅申報。)
The accountant used the declining balance method of depreciation to calculate this year equipment expense. (會計師使用遞減折舊法計算設備今年的費用。)
The lender recorded a deed of trust to secure the commercial property loan. (貸款機構登記信託契據，作為商用不動產貸款的擔保。)
The borrower may default on the loan if monthly payments continue to arrive late. (如果每月付款持續遲交，借款人可能會拖欠貸款。)
The supplier offered deferred payment terms to help the retailer manage seasonal cash flow. (供應商提供延期付款條件，協助零售商管理季節性現金流。)
The travel agent included the departure tax in the final price shown on the itinerary. (旅行社將離境稅列入行程單所示的最終價格。)
The tax adviser calculated the depreciation allowance for equipment purchased during the fiscal year. (稅務顧問計算了會計年度內購置設備的折舊扣除額。)
The monthly report includes a depreciation charge for the delivery vehicles and warehouse equipment. (月報列入配送車輛與倉儲設備的折舊費用。)
The accountant applied the correct depreciation rate when preparing the annual tax schedule for each asset. (會計師為每項資產編製年度稅務表時，採用了正確的折舊率。)
The bank offered a derivative instrument to help the exporter manage changes in currency prices. (銀行提供衍生性金融商品，協助出口商管理匯率變動。)
The employee submitted the required forms to apply for a disability benefit through the company plan. (員工提交所需表格，申請公司方案中的失能給付。)
The benefits adviser explained how disability insurance can replace part of an employee income. (福利顧問說明了失能保險如何補貼員工部分收入。)
The survey links higher disposable income with increased spending at local restaurants and shops. (調查指出，可支配所得增加與當地餐廳和商店消費上升有關。)
The audit found that one contractor was double dipping by billing two departments for the same service. (稽核發現一名承包商對同一服務向兩個部門重複請款。)
The retailer reported stronger demand for durable goods such as refrigerators and office equipment. (零售商回報冰箱與辦公設備等耐久財的需求增加。)
The university invested its endowment fund carefully to support scholarships and campus operations. (大學謹慎投資捐贈基金，以支持獎學金與校務運作。)
The accountant checked whether the client dinner qualified for an entertainment deduction under current rules. (會計師確認客戶晚宴是否符合現行規定的娛樂費扣除資格。)
The bank offered an equity credit line after reviewing the homeowner credit history and property value. (銀行審查屋主信用紀錄與房屋價值後，提供房屋淨值額度。)
The union contract includes an escalator clause that adjusts wages when the cost of living rises. (工會合約包含調整條款，會在生活成本上升時調整薪資。)
The accountant adjusted two ledger entries to even up the regional offices' quarterly expense balances. (會計人員調整兩筆帳目，拉平各區域辦公室的季度費用餘額。)
The finance team reviews travel expenses every quarter to identify unusual changes across the company's regional offices. (財務團隊每季檢視差旅費，找出公司各區域辦公室的異常變化。)
The bank disclosed its exchange premium before processing the travelers currency order. (銀行在處理旅客外幣訂單前，說明了換匯手續費。)
The board declared an extra dividend after reviewing the company strong annual earnings. (董事會檢視公司強勁的年度獲利後，宣布發放額外股利。)
The external firm completed a financial audit before the company released its annual report. (公司發布年度報告前，外部事務所完成了財務稽核。)
The company will introduce its revised budget at the start of the next fiscal year. (公司將在下一個會計年度開始時公布修訂後的預算。)
The finance team adjusted its overseas budget to account for the fluctuating exchange rate. (財務團隊調整海外預算，以因應浮動匯率。)
The small retailer had to fork out extra fees when the carrier reclassified its oversized display shipment. (承運商重新分類這批超大型展示品貨件後，小型零售商只得多付額外費用。)
The importer arranged a forward transaction to lock in the currency price for a shipment due in June. (進口商安排遠期交易，鎖定六月到貨的匯率。)
The accountant filed the franchise tax return before the state deadline at the end of the month. (會計師在月底州政府期限前提交了特許稅申報表。)
The board supported the friendly takeover after both companies agreed on the leadership transition. (兩家公司同意領導層交接後，董事會支持這項友善收購。)
The proposal would raise gasoline tax revenue to fund road repairs across the county. (提案將提高汽油稅收入，用於全郡道路修繕。)
The bookkeeper posted the adjustment to the general ledger before preparing the monthly report. (簿記員在編製月報前，將調整項目過帳至總分類帳。)
The finance office updated its invoice template to show the goods and service tax separately. (財務部更新發票範本，將商品服務稅分開列示。)
The report compares gross domestic product across the region and highlights growth in service industries. (報告比較區域各地的國內生產毛額，並指出服務業成長。)
The finance manager reviewed gross margin by product line before recommending changes to retail prices. (財務經理在建議調整零售價格前，檢視各產品線的毛利率。)
The quarterly statement lists gross profit before operating expenses and taxes are deducted. (季度報表列出營業費用與稅金扣除前的毛利。)
The board asked analysts why gross profit margin declined despite higher sales this quarter. (儘管本季銷售提高，董事會仍請分析師說明毛利率下降的原因。)
The auditor compared gross revenue with bank deposits to verify the company annual accounts. (稽核人員比較總營收與銀行存款，以核對公司年度帳目。)
The gross sales increased after the retailer extended store hours and introduced a weekend promotion. (零售商延長營業時間並推出週末促銷後，總銷售額增加。)
The late-payment penalty seemed harsh on smaller retailers already struggling with the new inventory system. (對已在適應新庫存系統的小型零售商而言，這筆逾期付款罰金似乎太嚴苛。)
The lender requires hazard insurance before approving the mortgage for the commercial property. (貸款機構要求先投保災害保險，才會核准商用不動產抵押貸款。)
The hedge fund disclosed its quarterly results to investors during a conference call on Tuesday morning. (這家避險基金在週二上午的電話會議中向投資人公布季度成果。)
The bank approved a home equity loan after reviewing the property appraisal and the customer income documents. (銀行審查房屋估價與客戶收入文件後，核准了房屋貸款。)
The board rejected the hostile takeover offer and asked advisers to evaluate other strategic options. (董事會拒絕了惡意收購提議，並請顧問評估其他策略選項。)
The bank added extra account alerts to help customers detect identity theft before fraudulent charges appear. (銀行新增帳戶通知，協助客戶在詐騙扣款出現前察覺身分盜用。)
A service charge is implicit in the quoted total, although the proposal does not list it as a separate item. (報價總額內含服務費，儘管提案沒有將它列為獨立項目。)
Please pay the outstanding balance in full before the end of the month. (請在月底前付清未繳餘額。)
The survey compares spending habits across each income bracket in the metropolitan area. (這項調查比較都會區各所得級距的消費習慣。)
Employees can consult the online guide to estimate how the revised income tax bracket affects withholding. (員工可參考線上指南，估算修訂後的所得稅級距如何影響預扣稅額。)
The finance team explained how the proposed indirect tax would affect prices for imported office supplies. (財務團隊說明了擬議中的間接稅將如何影響進口辦公用品的價格。)

meaning: phr. 內線消息；內幕資訊
example: Executives must report any insider information they receive before trading company shares. (主管在交易公司股票前，必須申報收到的任何內線消息。)

meaning: phr. 內線交易；內幕交易
example: The regulator investigated suspected insider trading after a manager sold shares days before the announcement. (主管在公告前幾天賣出股票後，監管機關調查這起疑似內線交易。)
The supplier waived the installation charge after the client agreed to order equipment for all branches. (客戶同意為所有分店訂購設備後，供應商免收安裝費。)

meaning: phr. 分期貸款；分期借款
example: The customer chose an installment loan with fixed monthly payments instead of using a high interest credit card. (客戶選擇每月固定還款的分期貸款，而不使用高利率信用卡。)

meaning: phr. 分期付款方案；分期計畫
example: The appliance retailer offered an installment plan so the customer could spread payments over six months. (家電零售商提供分期付款方案，讓客戶能在六個月內分攤費用。)

meaning: phr. 保險經紀人；保險代理人
example: An insurance broker reviewed the company coverage and suggested adding protection for rented vehicles. (保險經紀人檢視公司的保障內容後，建議增加租用車輛的保障。)
The insurer lowered the insurance premium after the company installed updated alarms at every warehouse. (公司在每座倉庫安裝新型警報器後，保險公司降低了保費。)

meaning: phr. 無形資產；非實體資產
example: The merger valuation included the brand name as an intangible asset rather than a physical item. (合併估值將品牌名稱列為無形資產，而非實體項目。)

meaning: phr. 內部稽核員；內部審計師
example: The internal auditor reviewed purchasing records and reported control weaknesses directly to the board. (內部稽核員檢查採購紀錄後，直接向董事會報告控管弱點。)

meaning: phr. 存貨會計；庫存核算
example: The new inventory accounting system records damaged stock separately from products available for sale. (新的存貨會計系統將受損品與可銷售商品分開記錄。)

meaning: phr. 投資顧問；理財顧問
example: The investment advisor reviewed the client portfolio before discussing a lower risk retirement strategy. (投資顧問檢視客戶投資組合後，討論較低風險的退休規劃。)

meaning: phr. 投資銀行家；投資銀行員
example: An investment banker advised the family owned business on raising capital without selling its controlling stake. (投資銀行員協助家族企業籌資，同時避免出售控制股權。)

meaning: phr. 垃圾債券；高風險債券
example: The investment fund avoided a junk bond issued by a company already struggling to refinance its debt. (投資基金避開了一家已難以重新融資的公司所發行的垃圾債券。)
The finance office kept back a small reserve to cover unexpected customs fees and urgent equipment repairs. (財務辦公室保留了一小筆準備金，用來支付意外關稅與緊急設備維修費。)
The procurement team negotiated annual rates to keep down shipping costs without reducing delivery frequency. (採購團隊協商年度費率，在不降低配送頻率的情況下控制運費。)
The company laid aside funds for replacement equipment after its maintenance audit identified several aging machines. (維護稽核發現數台機器老舊後，公司便存下一筆資金準備更換設備。)

meaning: phr. 領先指標；先行指標
example: Retail hiring often acts as a leading indicator of consumer demand in the regional economy. (零售業聘僱情況常是區域經濟消費需求的領先指標。)

meaning: phr. 分類帳分錄；帳簿紀錄
example: The accountant corrected a ledger entry after discovering that the vendor invoice had been posted twice. (會計師發現廠商發票重複入帳後，更正了一筆分類帳分錄。)
After several months of rapid growth, monthly expenses began to level off. (快速成長數月後，每月支出開始趨於平穩。)

meaning: phr. 槓桿收購；融資收購
example: The private equity group financed a leveraged buyout using loans secured against the acquired company assets. (私募股權公司以收購標的資產作擔保融資，完成槓桿收購。)
The adviser compared life assurance policies before recommending coverage for the client family. (顧問比較各種人壽保險方案後，才建議客戶家庭的保障內容。)

meaning: phr. 有限查核；局部審計
example: The lender accepted a limited audit while the family owned business prepared its first full financial statements. (家族企業準備首份完整財務報表期間，貸方接受先進行有限查核。)

meaning: phr. 流動性危機；資金短缺
example: The lender faced a liquidity crisis when several large clients withdrew deposits during the market panic. (市場恐慌期間，數名大型客戶提領存款，使貸方陷入流動性危機。)

meaning: phr. 遊說支出；政治遊說費
example: The annual filing listed each lobbying expense and identified the legislation the company sought to influence. (年度申報列出每筆遊說支出，並說明公司試圖影響的法案。)
The contractor requested a lump sum after completing the repairs instead of several monthly installments. (承包商完成修繕後要求一次支付總額，而不是分成數期付款。)
The bank replaced her card after its magnetic stripe stopped working at several store terminals. (磁條在多家商店的終端機都無法使用後，銀行為她換發新卡。)
The vendor made good on its warranty and replaced the defective scanner before the warehouse began its morning shift. (廠商履行保固承諾，在倉庫早班開始前換掉故障的掃描器。)
The accounts clerk could barely make out the handwritten account number, so she contacted the customer before processing payment. (會計助理幾乎看不清手寫的帳號，因此在處理付款前先聯絡客戶確認。)
The distributor marked up imported accessories to cover freight charges, customs fees, and additional handling costs. (經銷商調高進口配件價格，以支付運費、關稅和額外處理成本。)
The fund compared market capitalisation across firms before deciding which shares belonged in its index. (基金在決定哪些股票納入指數前，比較了各公司的市值。)
Investors watched a decline in market capitalization after quarterly sales missed the company forecast. (投資人得知季度銷售額不如公司預期後，市值下跌。)
The lender extended the maturity date after the borrower requested more time to refinance the loan. (借款人要求更多時間重新融資後，貸方延長了到期日。)

meaning: phr. 商人銀行；商業銀行
example: The merchant bank arranged financing for the acquisition and advised both companies on the transaction. (商人銀行為這起收購安排融資，並就交易向兩家公司提供建議。)
The finance director reviewed each monetary resource before approving the department's revised spending plan. (財務主管核對每項資金來源後，核准部門修訂過的支出計畫。)

meaning: phr. 貨幣制度；金融體系
example: The analyst explained how changes to the monetary system could affect exchange rates and local prices. (分析師說明貨幣制度的變動可能如何影響匯率與當地物價。)
The bank strengthened its checks after investigators linked several overseas transfers to money laundering. (調查人員發現數筆海外匯款與洗錢有關後，銀行加強了查核。)
Unpaid service charges mounted up during the dispute, so the account manager requested a payment plan before renewal. (爭議期間未付的服務費逐漸累積，因此客戶經理在續約前提出付款方案。)
The investor followed debate over the national debt ceiling because it could unsettle financial markets. (投資人關注國債上限的辯論，因為這可能使金融市場動盪。)
The supplier listed a nominal price, but delivery fees and taxes were added to the final invoice. (供應商列出名目價格，但最終發票另加了運費與稅金。)
The accountant compared the bond's nominal value with its market price before recording the purchase. (會計師登錄這筆債券前，先比較它的票面價值與市場價格。)

meaning: phr. 應付票據；應付本票
example: The vendor accepted a note payable due in sixty days instead of an immediate wire transfer. (供應商接受一張六十天後到期的應付票據，取代立即電匯。)

meaning: phr. 應收票據；應收本票
example: The auditor confirmed that the note receivable was recorded in the correct quarter. (稽核人員確認這筆應收票據已記入正確季度。)

meaning: phr. 數據運算；數字分析
example: After weeks of number crunching, finance found a smaller budget that still protected essential customer services. (財務部經過數週的數字分析，找出較精簡的預算並保住必要客服服務。)
On average, the downtown store processes about three hundred customer orders each day. (市中心門市平均每天處理約三百筆顧客訂單。)
The bond traded below par value even though the issuer continued making every scheduled payment. (即使發行機構持續按期付款，這檔債券的交易價格仍低於票面價值。)
The owner was reluctant to part with the original equipment, but the repair estimate exceeded the cost of replacement. (業主不太願意割愛原有設備，但維修報價已超過更換成本。)
The borrower paid back the equipment loan ahead of schedule after receiving the reimbursement from its insurance provider. (借款方收到保險公司的理賠款後，提前償還了設備貸款。)
The contractor paid up the outstanding balance before the deadline, avoiding additional fees under the revised service agreement. (承包商在期限前付清未結餘額，避免依新版服務協議產生額外費用。)

meaning: phr. 薪資支票；薪水支票
example: The payroll check arrived late, so the employee contacted human resources to confirm the mailing address. (薪資支票晚到，員工便聯絡人資部確認郵寄地址。)

meaning: phr. 盯住匯率；固定匯率
example: A pegged exchange rate can limit sudden currency swings but requires careful management of foreign reserves. (盯住匯率可限制貨幣劇烈波動，但需要審慎管理外匯存底。)
The lease charges interest at six percent per annum on overdue balances, with statements sent to tenants each quarter. (租約規定逾期餘額按年息百分之六計息，並每季寄送帳單給承租人。)
The annual report compares per capita spending across branches to identify locations that may need additional customer service resources. (年報比較各分店的人均支出，以找出可能需要增加客服資源的據點。)

meaning: phr. 人均所得；平均收入
example: The economic report compared per capita income across regions before recommending changes to the subsidy formula. (經濟報告比較各地區的人均所得後，才建議調整補助計算方式。)

meaning: phr. 個人支票；私人支票
example: The supplier accepted a personal cheque for the deposit but requested a bank transfer for the balance. (供應商接受以個人支票支付訂金，但要求尾款用銀行轉帳。)
The office manager replenished petty cash after staff used it for postage and emergency supplies. (員工用零用金支付郵資與緊急用品後，辦公室經理補足了款項。)
The fund added precious metal holdings to balance its exposure to volatile technology shares. (基金增持貴金屬，以平衡科技股波動帶來的風險。)

meaning: phr. 優質帳戶；尊榮帳戶
example: The bank offered a premium account with reduced transfer fees to clients maintaining higher monthly balances. (銀行為每月維持較高餘額的客戶提供轉帳手續費較低的優質帳戶。)

meaning: phr. 非公開發行公司；私人公司
example: The privately held corporation delayed its expansion until the owners secured a long term credit line. (這家非公開發行公司等到業主取得長期信用額度後，才延後擴張計畫。)
A progressive tax would raise the rate on higher incomes while leaving lower brackets unchanged. (累進稅會提高高所得者的稅率，同時維持較低所得級距不變。)

meaning: phr. 促銷費用；推廣開支
example: Finance approved the promotional expense after reviewing the campaign plan and vendor estimates. (財務部審查活動計畫與廠商估價後，核准了這筆促銷費用。)
Emergency financing helped prop up the distributor while it renegotiated overdue invoices with several major suppliers. (緊急融資協助經銷商在與幾家主要供應商重新協商逾期帳款時維持營運。)
Under a proportional tax, every taxpayer pays the same percentage of taxable income. (採比例稅時，每位納稅人都按相同比率繳納應稅所得。)
The board kept the purse strings tight until managers presented a credible plan for reducing operating costs. (主管提出可信的營運成本縮減計畫前，董事會一直緊抓經費控制權。)
The finance team put aside funds for equipment repairs after its annual inspection identified several aging machines. (年度檢查發現多台機器老舊後，財務團隊預留了設備維修經費。)
The airline racked up additional compensation costs after several cancellations left passengers waiting overnight at regional airports. (多個航班取消，旅客被迫在地區機場過夜，航空公司因此累積了額外補償成本。)

meaning: phr. 不時之需；困難時期
example: The restaurant owner set aside part of each strong month for a rainy day. (餐廳老闆每逢生意好的月份，都存下一部分以備不時之需。)
After two quarters in the red, the retailer changed suppliers to reduce red ink and stabilize cash flow. (連續兩季虧損後，零售商更換供應商以減少赤字並穩定現金流。)

meaning: phr. 租金收入；租賃所得
example: The property manager recorded rental income monthly and reported overdue payments to the accounting department. (物業經理每月記錄租金收入，並向會計部門回報逾期款項。)
The lender lowered the repayment rate for borrowers who enrolled in its automatic payment program. (貸款機構為加入自動扣款方案的借款人調降了還款率。)

meaning: phr. 重置成本；替換成本
example: The insurer calculated replacement cost before approving the claim for equipment damaged in the warehouse fire. (保險公司核准倉庫火災設備理賠前，先計算了重置成本。)
The cashier rang up the customer's supplies separately so the business could claim the correct tax deduction. (收銀員將顧客的用品分開結帳，讓公司能申報正確的稅額扣抵。)
The department ran up extra charges by extending the equipment rental for another week. (部門延長設備租期一週，因此累積了額外費用。)

meaning: phr. 空殼公司；空殼法人
example: Compliance officers flagged the shell entity after payments bypassed the supplier's registered accounts. (款項繞過供應商的登記帳戶後，法遵人員將這家空殼公司列為警示對象。)
The firm had to shell out for urgent repairs after inspectors found a serious safety problem. (檢查人員發現嚴重安全問題後，公司不得不支付緊急維修費。)
The owner signed over the company vehicle to the regional manager when she transferred to the new branch. (業主在區域主管調任新分公司時，簽字將公司車輛轉交給她。)
The firm issued a stock certificate after its transfer agent verified the investor's purchase and recorded the shares. (過戶代理人確認投資人完成購買並登記股數後，公司便核發股票憑證。)
Investors received a stock dividend instead of cash while the company preserved funds for its planned expansion. (公司保留資金準備擴張，因此投資人收到的是股票股利而非現金。)
An experienced stock trader reduced client exposure after the central bank announced an unexpected rate increase. (央行意外宣布升息後，資深股票交易員降低了客戶的持股風險。)
After taxes and insurance, the employee takes home about three thousand dollars each month. (扣除稅款和保險後，這名員工每月實領約三千美元。)

meaning: phr. 課稅級距；所得級距
example: Her annual bonus pushed part of her salary into a higher tax bracket. (她的年終獎金使部分薪資落入較高的課稅級距。)

meaning: phr. 稅額扣除；抵稅項目
example: The accountant confirmed that the home office equipment qualified for a tax deduction this year. (會計師確認居家辦公設備今年符合稅額扣除資格。)

meaning: phr. 暫時支撐；渡過難關
example: A short-term credit line helped tide the manufacturer over while a delayed customer payment cleared through the bank. (一筆短期信用額度協助製造商暫時支撐，等候延遲的客戶款項入帳。)

meaning: phr. 節省開支；縮衣節食
example: With revenue declining, the store network tightened its belt by postponing renovations and renegotiating several service contracts. (營收下滑後，連鎖門市延後整修並重新協商幾份服務合約，以節省開支。)
Please submit your receipts within five days so payroll can include them in your travel allowance. (請在五天內交收據，讓薪資部門把費用列入差旅津貼。)
Employees can request travel reimbursement after their manager approves the trip report. (員工可在主管核准差旅報告後申請差旅報銷。)
The company plans to sell some treasury stock to fund its new distribution center. (公司計畫出售部分庫藏股，為新的配送中心籌措資金。)

meaning: phr. 調整至正確；核對平衡
example: Finance trued up the quarterly accruals after receiving corrected invoices from three vendors before closing the books. (財務部在結帳前收到三家廠商的更正發票，隨後調整季度應計款項。)

meaning: phr. 蒙受虧損；出現虧損
example: The retailer turned a loss last quarter after freight expenses rose sharply and several seasonal products remained unsold. (運費大幅上漲且多項季節商品滯銷後，零售商上季出現虧損。)
The new service began to turn a profit after subscription revenue covered staffing, licensing, and customer support expenses. (訂閱收入足以支付人事、授權和客服成本後，新服務開始獲利。)
The finance team uses variance analysis to explain why monthly expenses exceeded the budget. (財務團隊用差異分析說明每月支出超出預算的原因。)
A venture capitalist agreed to review the startup’s sales forecast and funding proposal. (一位創投家同意審閱新創公司的銷售預測和募資提案。)

meaning: phr. 批發物價指數；批發價格指數
example: Procurement managers tracked the wholesale price index before renegotiating annual supply contracts. (採購主管重新協商年度供應合約前，追蹤了批發物價指數。)
Unexpected repair costs could wipe out the department’s remaining budget this quarter. (意外維修費可能耗盡部門本季剩餘預算。)
The payroll team calculated withholding tax before transferring each employee’s monthly salary. (薪資團隊計算預扣稅額後，才將每位員工的月薪匯出。)
The finance director decided to write off damaged equipment after reviewing the repair estimate. (財務主管檢視維修估價後，決定把受損設備認列為損失。)
